Quarry.Effect_spend00000000000: You [[/surge 1]] for each Advantage spent. You can use these surges only on your first strike against the Marked target this round.
Quarry.Effect_before0000000000:
The target is Marked by you until the end of the encounter, until it dies, or until you use this ability on another target. [[/apply QR00000000marked]] You always know a Marked target’s direction and general distance from you while it is within the same hive stratum, even through walls or cover.

The first strike you make against a Marked target each round deals +1 damage at Echelon 1, +2 at Echelon 2, +3 at Echelon 3, and +4 at Echelon 4.

RangedReflex.Name: Ranged Reflex
RangedReflex.Description: The shooter finds the calm in the perch. Your ranged strikes gain an edge against any target that is at least 5 squares away from you and Marked by you.

SteadyTheScope.Name: Steady the Scope
SteadyTheScope.Story: You feel the wind, hold the breath, wait the beat.
SteadyTheScope.Trigger: You would take a bane on a ranged strike from being observed, dazed, harried, or knocked off a firing position.
SteadyTheScope.Effect_before0000000000: You ignore the bane on this strike, and you [[/surge 1]] that you can use only on this strike.

ColdRead.Name: Cold Read
ColdRead.Description: The first Marked target you damage from 5 or more squares away each round becomes visible to all your allies through walls and cover (a thermal-signature call-out from your smartlink to their HUDs) until the start of your next turn.

CalledShotVitals.Name: Called Shot (Vitals)
CalledShotVitals.Story: Center of the mark, where the body can’t afford to lose it.
CalledShotVitals.Effect_after00000000000: If the target is Marked by you, this ability deals 2 extra damage.

CalledShotCommlink.Name: Called Shot (Comm-link)
CalledShotCommlink.Story: You put the round through their comm rig, and their crew goes quiet.

RangeDiscipline.Name: Range Discipline
RangeDiscipline.Description: Any Scout ability that has a ranged distance of 5 has a ranged distance of 10 for you. Additionally, your Quarry first-strike damage bonus doubles (+2 at Echelon 1, +4 at Echelon 2, +6 at Echelon 3, +8 at Echelon 4).

OverwatchLane.Name: Overwatch Lane
OverwatchLane.Story: Pure Longshot control: you own a lane, and anything in it is yours.
OverwatchLane.Effect_before0000000000: You take a stance and designate a firing lane 5 squares wide within distance. Until the start of your next turn, the first enemy each turn to enter the lane or take an action inside it triggers a free ranged strike from you (main-action equivalent).

GhostRound.Name: Ghost Round
GhostRound.Story: A subsonic, thermally baffled round. Nobody sees where it came from.
GhostRound.Effect_after00000000000: The target and all enemies within 5 squares of the target don’t detect the shot’s origin: they can’t use the shot to impose a bane on you, and can’t mark your position for their allies. On a high result, you remain hidden from the target and its allies, even if observed.

SensorFusionSmartlink.Name: Sensor-Fusion Smartlink
SensorFusionSmartlink.Description: Your smartlink stack backs out the geometry: Marked targets gain no benefit from cover against you. Additionally, you can make ranged strikes with the Longshot Kit at a distance of 20.

OneShotOneKill.Name: One Shot One Kill
OneShotOneKill.Story: The Longshot Division’s promise: one trigger pull, one closed contract.
OneShotOneKill.Effect_after00000000000: A Marked target who is not a minion, leader, or solo creature and who is winded after taking this damage is reduced to 0 Stamina.

VantageTrap.Name: Vantage Trap
VantageTrap.Story: You pre-laid the kill zone: climb spots, mag-grip anchors, thermal-baffle panels, one dropped emitter.
VantageTrap.Effect_before0000000000: You place a zone with a 5-square radius within distance. Until the end of the encounter or until you leave the encounter map, you can make one free ranged strike (main-action equivalent) each round against an enemy who enters the zone or takes an action inside it. When you make that strike, you can move up to your speed for free.

Hunter.Name: Hunter
Hunter.Description:
“The Longshot.” Ironclad Longshot Division — a corporate black-program for the long-range marksman: optics, ballistics, static-position observation, and Ironclad’s sensor-fusion smartlink stack. You read a room from four hundred meters up, tag the mark, and call the shot before your crew crosses the threshold.

At 1st level you gain the Survival skill, the Quarry and Ranged Reflex features, and the Steady the Scope triggered action. Recommended Kit: Longshot.

GrapnelBlink.Name: Grapnel-Blink
GrapnelBlink.Story: A micro-jet grapnel burst, mag-grip catch, and gas-kick landing. From where they stand, it looks like a teleport. It isn’t.
GrapnelBlink.Effect_spend00000000000: You Blink 1 additional square for each Advantage spent.
GrapnelBlink.Effect_before0000000000: You Blink: you reposition up to 5 squares via your Blink Rig. If you have concealment or cover at your destination, you can use the Hide maneuver even if you are observed. If you successfully hide using this maneuver, you [[/surge 1]].

RigRecovery.Name: Rig Recovery
RigRecovery.Story: The Rig sees the hit coming half a beat before your brain does.
RigRecovery.Effect_spend00000000000: You Blink 1 additional square for each Advantage spent.
RigRecovery.Effect_before0000000000: You take half the damage, then can Blink up to 4 squares after the triggering effect resolves.

KickedSparks.Name: Kicked Sparks
KickedSparks.Description: The Rig’s compressed-gas thrust and mag-grip strike-plates throw off a thermal-kinetic bloom. The first time on a turn that you Blink away from or into a space adjacent to an enemy, that enemy takes thermal-kinetic damage equal to [[lookup @A]]{your Reflex score}. [[/damage @A]]

GrapnelSnatch.Name: Grapnel Snatch
GrapnelSnatch.Story: The grapnel bites into their harness and yanks them where you want them.

RigReflex.Name: Rig Reflex
RigReflex.Story: The Rig throws you clear and your hand is already moving.
RigReflex.Trigger: You use your Rig Recovery ability.
RigReflex.Effect_before0000000000: You ignore any effects associated with the damage that triggered your Rig Recovery ability. Before you Blink, you can make a free strike against a creature who damaged you to trigger Rig Recovery. After you Blink, you can spend a Recovery.

KillBlink.Name: Kill-Blink
KillBlink.Description: Whenever you reduce a non-minion creature to 0 Stamina, you can immediately use a free maneuver to use your Grapnel-Blink ability. Additionally, whenever you Blink, you can bring an adjacent willing creature along with you (the Rig’s tandem-carry mode). The creature appears in an unoccupied space adjacent to the space you Blinked into. If no such space exists, they can’t come with you.

RooftopSnap.Name: Rooftop Snap
RooftopSnap.Story: The grapnel hooks their harness, gear, or cyberlimb and hauls them up the wall.
RooftopSnap.Effect_after00000000000: A creature force moved by this ability must be moved straight upward.

StormTheVent.Name: Storm the Vent
StormTheVent.Story: Every Rig in the crew fires at once — or piggybacks on yours.
StormTheVent.Effect_before0000000000: Each target can Blink up to 5 squares. For each target in addition to you who Blinks away from or into a space adjacent to an enemy, that enemy takes thermal-kinetic damage equal to [[lookup @A]]{your Reflex score}. [[/damage @A]] Additionally, a target who ends this movement in concealment or cover can use the Hide maneuver even if they are observed.

RigNativeMovement.Name: Rig-Native Movement
RigNativeMovement.Description: Whenever you willingly move, you can Blink instead. When you Blink this way, it counts as using a Scout ability for the purpose of triggering your Kicked Sparks and Kill-Blink features.

ChainBlink.Name: Chain-Blink
ChainBlink.Story: Anchor, burst, catch, cut, anchor again — a chain of Blinks through the whole crew.
ChainBlink.Effect_before0000000000: You Blink up to twice your speed, making one power roll that targets each creature you come adjacent to during the Blink chain.

TheGrate.Name: The Grate
TheGrate.Story: They are alive. They are somewhere else. Deep-Dark Recovery will find them, or nobody will.
TheGrate.Effect_after00000000000: This ability deals thermal-kinetic damage. On a critical hit, the target is grapnel-hooked and dragged into the nearest unsealed vent, maintenance grate, or utility shaft, and doesn’t reappear on the encounter map.

Ghost.Name: Ghost
Ghost.Description:
“The Knife.” Ferrum Dynastic Deep-Dark Program — a corporate wetwork cadre trained in the sealed strata below the Warrens. You close the distance, take the target with a blade, and leave through a maintenance grate nobody knew was there. Your signature gear is the Blink Rig: a micro-jet grapnel, mag-grip gauntlets, and a compressed-gas kick module. When you Blink, you reposition via the Rig; it looks like a teleport, and it’s very good corp engineering.

At 1st level you gain the Demolitions skill (sabotage), the Grapnel-Blink ability, and the Rig Recovery triggered action. Recommended Kit: Ghost.

MaskRig.Name: Mask Rig
MaskRig.Story: Your dermal-holo array paints a friendly face; the Rig’s smartlink sells the arcology’s own badge geometry back to its sensors.
MaskRig.Effect_spend00000000000: Choose a creature whose size is no more than 1 greater than yours and who is within 10 squares. The Rig makes you appear as that creature: full body silhouette plus laryngeal voice modulation. You gain an edge on tests made to convince the creature’s allies that you are the creature.
MaskRig.Effect_before0000000000:
You activate the Rig. It makes you appear nonthreatening and harmless to your enemies — their HUDs read you as a low-priority civilian, badge-carrier, or maintenance worker. While the Rig is active, your strikes gain an edge, and when you take the Disengage move action, you gain a +1 bonus to the distance you can shift.

The Rig deactivates when you harm another creature, when you physically interact with a creature, when you use this ability again, or when you end it (no action required). If you end the Rig by harming another creature, you [[/surge 1]].

Diversion.Name: Diversion
Diversion.Story: A Rig-projected shout, a chest-cam glare, a badge-reader ping in the wrong direction.
Diversion.Trigger: An enemy targets you with a strike.
Diversion.Effect_before0000000000: Choose an enemy within distance of the triggering strike, including the enemy who targeted you. The strike targets that enemy instead.

WrongTarget.Name: Wrong Target
WrongTarget.Description:
Your Rig sells you as friendly hard enough to fool an area targeting system. Whenever an enemy uses an ability or trait that targets multiple of their allies and you are within distance of the effect, you can choose to be a target of the effect as well.

Additionally, when you activate your Mask Rig, you can take the Disengage move action as part of that activation.

VoiceThrow.Name: Voice Throw
VoiceThrow.Story: You throw a laryngeal-modulator projection into the crowd — a bark, a shout, an order.
VoiceThrow.Effect_after00000000000: This forced movement ignores stability. Instead, the forced movement is reduced by a number equal to the target’s Instinct score.

FaceCut.Name: Face-Cut
FaceCut.Story: A fast Rig-projected feint, and you’re somewhere they aren’t looking.
FaceCut.Trigger: Another creature targets you with a strike.
FaceCut.Effect_before0000000000: You use your Diversion ability with no Advantage cost against the triggering creature and strike. You can reposition to an unoccupied space within 3 squares of that creature and can make a free strike against them. You can then spend a Recovery.

FaceThief.Name: Face-Thief
FaceThief.Description: Whenever you reduce an adjacent non-minion creature to 0 Stamina, you can immediately use a free maneuver to activate your Mask Rig and then move up to your speed. If the creature is the same size as you, your Rig can present as them (a stolen face capture from your chin-line optics) without spending Advantage. If you do, while the Rig is active, the corpse is dermal-holographed to look like you. The projection on the body ends if another creature physically interacts with it. When the projection would end for either you or the corpse, it ends for both.

EverybodysLooking.Name: Everybody’s Looking
EverybodysLooking.Story: Your Rig broadcasts a swarm of projection decoys; their targeting systems track three ghosts of every friendly.
EverybodysLooking.Effect_before0000000000: Until the start of your next turn, any ability roll made against a target gains an edge.

WearThem.Name: Wear Them
WearThem.Story: The Rig sells them the wrong enemy, then speaks with their commander’s voice.
WearThem.Effect_after00000000000: You choose the new targets for the original target’s free strike or ability. Additionally, if your Rig is active (you are hidden or disguised), using this ability doesn’t cause you to be revealed.

Blend.Name: Blend
Blend.Description: Your movement no longer provokes opportunity attacks (the Rig sells you as staff or civilian to the targeting stack). Additionally, you can use your Face-Thief feature as a free triggered action when a creature is reduced to 0 Stamina by your Diversion ability.

IAmYou.Name: I Am You
IAmYou.Story: Your Rig runs a full-fidelity capture of the target — retina, gait, voice, badge chip.
IAmYou.Effect_before0000000000: Until the end of the encounter, you gain the target’s damage immunities and speed (if they are better than yours), and can use any types of movement they can use. You can also use the target’s signature ability, using their bonus for the power roll.

TheWearersCut.Name: The Wearer’s Cut
TheWearersCut.Story: The target sees a friend, a lover, a boss — and dies mid-relief.
TheWearersCut.Effect_after00000000000: If your Mask Rig disguises you as a creature the target knew, this ability deals extra [[/damage 3*@A]]{damage} equal to three times your Reflex score.

FaceInCrowd.Name: Face-in-crowd
FaceInCrowd.Description:
“The Mask.” Nyx Cartel Mask-Line — the street-independent face-thief crew that slips through corp badges wearing someone else’s face. Where a Ferrum knife takes a target hard, a Nyx Mask takes them soft. Your signature gear is the Mask Rig: a dermal-holographic projection array, synth-skin face-plate, laryngeal voice modulator, and an off-brand smartlink that hijacks badge geometry in real time. It isn’t illusion magic; it’s very good black-market chrome.

At 1st level you gain the Deception skill (lie), the Mask Rig ability, and the Diversion triggered action. Recommended Kit: Ghost or Saturation.

Class.Name: Scout
Class.Description:
You are a Scout — on a clean corp badge an “asymmetric-operations specialist,” on the street a ghost, a shade, a kite, or simply the knife. You are the crew’s infiltrator, marksman, long eye, and assassin: somewhere else the moment the fight arrives, and already gone the moment it’s over. Where the Operator wins the firefight with discipline and chrome, you win it by never being in the fight the enemy thought they were in.

You are fully mundane — no Veil, no Signal, no magic. Your edge is the read: the disciplined study of an enemy’s tells, feeding a stack of chrome and gear that turns the read into precision. From it you bank Advantage and spend it on precision strikes, escapes, misdirections, and kills so decisive the target is dead before they know they were engaged.

You trained at one of three schools, and your school is your subclass: Hunter (Ironclad Longshot Division), Ghost (Ferrum Dynastic Deep-Dark Program), or Face-in-crowd (Nyx Cartel Mask-Line).

Core characteristics: Reflex, Logic · Heroic resource: Advantage · Starting Stamina: 18 (+6 per level) · Recoveries: 8 · Kit: yes (light Kits).

Class.Name: Commander
Class.Description:
You are a Commander — on the street the boss, the voice, or simply the one who does the talking. Corp paperwork, when it bothers to name you at all, files you as a “liaison,” “talent,” or “handler.” None of that captures what you actually are: the crew’s voice and its will, the one who wins the room and directs the fight without ever firing a shot.

Where the Operator wins the firefight and the Hacker owns the net, you win the room — and when the room turns loud, you’re at the crew’s shoulder calling the shots that let everyone else fight above their weight. Your power is command presence: the trained, magnetic authority of someone people listen to. Your own damage is low by design; your impact, measured in what your allies accomplish because of you, is the highest in the game.

You are fully mundane — no Veil, no Wired specialty — and chrome-positive: Cyborgs make superb Commanders. Every doctrine, the Bard included, carries no magic-erosion penalty.

You run on two battlefields with one skill set: a combat Mark for the fight and a social Mark (Read the Room) for the negotiation, both fed by Influence. Your subclass is your Command Doctrine: Street-Fixer, Corp-Exec, or Bard.

Core characteristics: Persona, Instinct · Heroic resource: Influence · Starting Stamina: 21 (+9 per level) · Recoveries: 10 · Kit: yes (light Kits).

Influence.Name: Influence
Influence.Description:
Influence is your command authority made mechanical: momentum earned by leading and reading people well, spent on heroic abilities and signature enhancements. You are fully mundane: Influence is never bought, raised, or fed by nuyen, Renown, or Body Integrity, and it never converts to them.

Influence in Combat

At the start of a combat encounter or some other stressful situation tracked in combat rounds (as determined by the Director), you gain Influence equal to [[lookup @hero.victories]]{your Victories}. At the start of each of your turns during combat, you [[/gain 2 hr]]{gain 2 Influence} (3 at 7th level from Heightened Influence, 4 at 10th level from True Influence).

Additionally, you gain 1 Influence the first time each combat round that:

  • any ally within 10 squares of you damages a creature Marked by you ([[/gain 1 hr]]);

  • any ally within 10 squares of you uses a heroic ability ([[/gain 1 hr]]);

  • you succeed on a Read the Room that reveals new information ([[/gain 1 hr]]).

You lose any remaining Influence at the end of the encounter.

Influence Outside of Combat

Though you can’t gain Influence outside of combat, in a social scene (a negotiation, an infiltration, a performance) you can use your heroic abilities and effects that cost Influence without spending it. Whenever you do, you can’t use that same ability or effect outside of combat again until you earn 1 or more Victories or finish a respite.

Two Marks

You can have one combat Mark (the Mark signature) and one social Mark (the Read the Room signature) active at the same time. Each track has its own target, duration, and benefits. Abilities that refer to a “Marked” creature mean your combat Mark unless they say otherwise.

In Foundry, Influence costs are enforced in combat at the ability’s full cost. The per-turn drip is a flat 2; at 7th and 10th level, add the extra with the Heightened Influence and True Influence buttons.

FieldPresence.Name: Field Presence
FieldPresence.Description: You are not a Kit-forward class — most of your impact comes through allies, not personal weapon technique — but you can use and gain the benefits of a light Kit (no armor or light armor, and no heavy weapon) when your build calls for personal self-sufficiency in a fight: a Corp-Exec running executive protection, or a Street-Fixer who backs their word with a gun.

ReadTheAngles.Name: Read the Angles
ReadTheAngles.Description: The leader who has already read the battlefield before the first shot is fired. At the start of an encounter, you can use a free triggered action to use your Mark ability against one enemy you have line of effect to, even if you are surprised. You can then slide the Marked target up to 3 squares, ignoring stability. The target can’t be moved in a way that would harm them (such as over a ledge), leave them dying, or result in them suffering a condition or other negative effect.

WatchTheirWeaknesses.Name: Watch Their Weaknesses
WatchTheirWeaknesses.Description: The first time each combat round that an ally damages a creature Marked by you, or that you succeed on a Read the Room, you gain 2 Influence instead of 1. [[/gain 1 hr]]{Gain the extra Influence.}

ImprovedFieldPresence.Name: Improved Field Presence
ImprovedFieldPresence.Description: If you have a Kit, you gain an edge on power rolls made with your Kit’s signature abilities.

MasterOfWords.Name: Master of Words
MasterOfWords.Description: Once per round, you can negate a bane on a power roll made with your Kit’s signature abilities (if you have a Kit).

HeightenedInfluence.Name: Heightened Influence
HeightenedInfluence.Description: At the start of each of your turns during combat, you gain 3 Influence instead of 2. [[/gain 1 hr]]{Gain the extra Influence.}

SeizeTheInitiativeFeature.Name: Seize the Initiative
SeizeTheInitiativeFeature.Description:
If your side is not surprised when combat begins, your side goes first.

If an enemy has an ability that allows their side to go first, roll as usual to determine who goes first.

This feature is separate from the 1-Influence heroic ability of the same name.

GrandmasterOfWords.Name: Grandmaster of Words
GrandmasterOfWords.Description: Once per encounter, a power roll made with your Kit’s signature abilities (if you have a Kit) automatically counts as a high (17+) result.

Command.Name: Command
Command.Description: You have an epic resource called Command: the authority a great leader radiates doesn’t vanish the instant the fight ends. The first Influence you would lose at the end of an encounter (up to 2) instead carries into the next scene as Command. You can spend Command exactly like Influence, but only on your very next activation of an ability or effect that costs Influence.

TrueInfluence.Name: True Influence
TrueInfluence.Description: At the start of each of your turns during combat, you gain 4 Influence instead of 3. [[/gain 1 hr]]{Gain the extra Influence.}

MasterOfVoice.Name: Master of Voice
MasterOfVoice.Description:
Whenever an ally makes a power roll against a creature Marked by you or the target of your Read the Room, they roll three dice and choose which two to use.

Additionally, heroic abilities that target one or more creatures Marked by you cost 2 less Influence (minimum 1).

DirectAlly.Name: Direct Ally
DirectAlly.Story: The crew simply fights better with you calling it.
DirectAlly.Effect_before0000000000:
The target must be able to see or hear you. Choose one:

  • The target gains an edge on their next power roll.

  • The target can move up to their speed.

  • The target deals +1 damage on their next strike, or gains +1 damage reduction until the start of their next turn.
DirectAlly.Effect_spend00000000000: You target up to 3 allies instead of one, or you upgrade the benefit: the movement becomes a free strike, the edge becomes a double edge, or the damage bonus becomes +3.

Mark.Name: Mark
Mark.Story: You point at the thing that matters, and the whole crew gets better at dealing with it.
Mark.Effect_before0000000000:
This is your combat Mark. The target is [[/apply CMD0000000marked]]{Marked} by you until the end of the encounter, until you are dying, or until you use this ability again. You can have only one combat-Marked creature at a time (the Corp-Exec’s Anticipation raises this to two), and you can willingly end your Mark (no action required). When a creature Marked by you is reduced to 0 Stamina, you can use a free triggered action to Mark a new target within distance.

While a creature Marked by you is within your line of effect, you and allies within your line of effect gain an edge on power rolls made against it.

Your combat Mark is independent of your social Mark (Read the Room); both can be active at once.
Mark.Effect_spend00000000000:
Whenever you or an ally deals rolled damage to a creature Marked by you, you can spend 1 Influence as a free triggered action to gain one of the following benefits (only one per trigger):

  • The ability deals extra [[/damage 2*@P]]{damage} equal to twice your Persona score.

  • The creature dealing the damage can spend a Recovery.

  • The creature dealing the damage can shift up to [[lookup @P]]{your Persona score} squares.

  • If the damage was dealt with a melee ability, the Marked creature is [[/apply taunted turn]]{taunted} by you until the end of its next turn.

ReadTheRoom.Name: Read the Room
ReadTheRoom.Story: You read the mark across the table before they know they’re being read.
ReadTheRoom.Effect_before0000000000:
Distance: Sight or hearing, in a social scene.

This is your social Mark. The target is Read by you until the end of the scene, until the scene resets, or until you use this ability again. You can have only one Read NPC at a time; this doesn’t end your combat Mark.

When you Read the target, learn one of the following, whichever the Director judges easiest to read in the moment: a Motivation, a Pitfall, their current Attitude toward you or the crew, or a tell (for example, “she’s lying about the payout”). The first time each round this reveals new information, you gain 1 Influence ([[/gain 1 hr]]).

For the rest of the scene, you and your allies gain an edge on Persona-based argument rolls against the Read NPC.
ReadTheRoom.Effect_spend00000000000: When an ally makes an argument against the Read NPC and wins it (a middle or high result), you can spend 1 Influence as a free triggered action to choose one: learn a second piece of information about the NPC; grant that ally an edge on their next argument roll this scene; or move the NPC’s Interest up one step immediately.

TheRightWord.Name: The Right Word
TheRightWord.Story: The same charged line heals a friend’s nerve or breaks an enemy’s.
TheRightWord.Effect_before0000000000:
You can use this ability as a main action or a maneuver. The target must be able to see or hear you. Choose one mode:

  • Rally (ally): no power roll. End one fear or morale condition on the target (such as frightened or taunted), let them make a saving throw against one effect, or steel them: an edge on their next saving throw against fear, corruption, or dread.

  • Rattle (enemy): make the power roll below.
TheRightWord.Effect_spend00000000000: You target up to 3 creatures within distance instead of one, or you upgrade the effect: a rally ends all fear and morale conditions on the target, or a rattle’s condition lasts until the target ends it with a saving throw (save ends) instead.
TheRightWord.Tier2: Rattle: the target has a bane on their next power roll.
TheRightWord.Tier3: Rattle: the target is taunted by you until the end of their next turn, or frightened of you until the end of your next turn (your choice).

SeizeTheInitiative.Name: Seize the Initiative
SeizeTheInitiative.Story: The everyday warlord command: cheap, flexible, always useful.
SeizeTheInitiative.Effect_before0000000000: Choose one: the target can immediately move up to their speed; the target can make a free strike against a creature within their weapon’s distance; or, if the target hasn’t acted yet this round, they take their turn immediately after yours.

AWord.Name: A Word
AWord.Story: A quiet aside at exactly the right moment.
AWord.Effect_before0000000000: Choose one: the target gains an edge on their next power roll this round, or the target ends one frightened or taunted condition on themselves.

CoordinatedAssault.Name: Coordinated Assault
CoordinatedAssault.Story: The moment the crew moves as one strike team.
CoordinatedAssault.Effect_before0000000000:
Choose one:

  • Each target gains an edge on their next strike this round, and that strike deals extra damage equal to [[lookup @P]]{your Persona score}.

  • One target gains an extra main action this turn.

CommandPresence.Name: Command Persona / Fearful Awe
CommandPresence.Story: The anti-morale teeth: area denial, aimed at will rather than bodies.
CommandPresence.Effect_before0000000000:
Choose one mode before you roll:

  • Command Persona: a 3 cube within 10 squares. The power roll decides how many enemies in the area are affected.

  • Fearful Awe: one enemy within 10 squares.
CommandPresence.Tier1: Command Persona: the enemy nearest the cube’s center has a bane on its next power roll. Fearful Awe: the target is weakened until the end of its next turn.
CommandPresence.Tier2: Command Persona: up to 2 enemies of your choice in the area are taunted by you until the end of their next turn. Fearful Awe: the target is taunted by you until the end of its next turn.
CommandPresence.Tier3: Command Persona: up to 3 enemies of your choice in the area are taunted by you until the end of their next turn and have a bane on their next power roll. Fearful Awe: the target is frightened of you (save ends).

BattleCry.Name: Battle Cry
BattleCry.Story: A leader’s voice cutting through the noise to put fresh wind in everyone’s sails.

ConcussiveCommand.Name: Concussive Command
ConcussiveCommand.Story: “Strike him down!” A single word turns an ally’s next hit into exactly the opening the crew needed.
ConcussiveCommand.Effect_before0000000000: One ally within 10 squares can make a free strike (using a signature ability) against the target. Roll to determine the command’s effect on that strike.
ConcussiveCommand.Tier1: The strike doesn’t gain an edge, and the target has a bane on its next power roll.
ConcussiveCommand.Tier2: The strike gains an edge; the target is dazed until the end of its next turn.
ConcussiveCommand.Tier3: The strike gains an edge; the target is dazed (save ends).

RallyTheCrew.Name: Rally the Crew
RallyTheCrew.Story: The mass pick-me-up: healing morale and momentum rather than wounds.
RallyTheCrew.Effect_before0000000000:
Combat: each ally in the area ends one condition on themselves, can spend a Recovery, gains temporary Stamina equal to [[lookup @P]]{your Persona score}, and gains an edge on their next power roll.

Social: in a social scene, instead either shift the room’s Attitude one full step, or grant the crew an edge on all social rolls for the rest of the scene.

CoordinatedStrike.Name: Coordinated Strike
CoordinatedStrike.Story: The hammer-and-anvil moment: you call the shot, and someone else lands it.
CoordinatedStrike.Effect_before0000000000: You designate the target, and your allies within 10 squares strike it.
CoordinatedStrike.Tier1: One ally makes a free strike against the target.
CoordinatedStrike.Tier2: One ally makes a free strike against the target with an edge.
CoordinatedStrike.Tier3: Two allies each make a free strike against the target with an edge.

Now.Name: Now!
Now.Story: The single sharpest word in your vocabulary.
Now.Effect_before0000000000: Each target can immediately make a free strike, using any signature ability that is a strike.

ThisIsWhatWePlannedFor.Name: This Is What We Planned For
ThisIsWhatWePlannedFor.Story: The plan you called three turns ago, clicking into place on schedule.
ThisIsWhatWePlannedFor.Effect_before0000000000: Each target who hasn’t acted yet this round takes their turn immediately after yours, in any order.

TurnTheTide.Name: Turn the Tide
TurnTheTide.Story: The moment. Not a repeatable button.
TurnTheTide.Effect_before0000000000:
Choose exactly one mode; the modes don’t stack.

  • Combat: each target gains a main action or a free strike this round, can move up to their speed, gains an edge on power rolls until the end of their next turn, and deals extra damage equal to [[lookup @P]]{your Persona score} on their strikes until the end of the round.

  • Social: the decisive stroke. Win the current negotiation exchange outright (skip its remaining arguments and secure the deal), or bend a powerful NPC to a major concession that lies within their actual authority (Director-adjudicated). This resolves the current scene decisively; it doesn’t erase ground already lost or bind the NPC in future scenes.

HitEmHard.Name: Hit ’Em Hard!
HitEmHard.Story: Every hit against your mark turns into fuel for whoever landed it.
HitEmHard.Effect_before0000000000: Until the end of the encounter or until you are dying, whenever you or any ally deals damage to a creature Marked by you, the creature who dealt the damage [[/surge 2]], which they can use immediately.

Rout.Name: Rout
Rout.Story: Once the line starts to break, it keeps breaking.
Rout.Effect_before0000000000: Until the end of the encounter or until you are dying, whenever you or any ally deals damage to a creature Marked by you whose Persona is lower than average, that creature is [[/apply frightened save]]{frightened} of the creature who dealt the damage (save ends).

BreakFormation.Name: Break Formation
BreakFormation.Story: The crew doesn’t just hit the mark; it reshapes the whole fight around it.
BreakFormation.Effect_before0000000000: Until the end of the encounter or until you are dying, the first time on a turn that you or any ally deals damage to a creature Marked by you, the creature who dealt the damage can push the Marked creature up to 2 squares, then shift up to 2 squares. Additionally, whenever an ally uses the Charge main action against a creature Marked by you, they can use a signature or heroic ability that is a strike instead of a free strike.

CoordinatedStrikeTeam.Name: Coordinated Strike Team
CoordinatedStrikeTeam.Story: The masterclass moment: everyone executes the play exactly as drilled.
CoordinatedStrikeTeam.Effect_before0000000000: Each target [[/surge 1]] and can use a signature ability as a free triggered action. That ability has a double edge on its power roll.

EmpireOfWords.Name: Empire of Words
EmpireOfWords.Story: You stop reacting to the room and start writing its script.
EmpireOfWords.Effect_before0000000000:
Distance: Social scene.

Set the frame of the negotiation for the rest of the scene. Choose one:

  • Force the negotiation’s topic to a subject of your choice.

  • Declare one Motivation you’ve learned on-record and unchangeable.

  • Declare one Pitfall neutralized for the rest of the scene.

  • Your next argument this scene automatically succeeds.

SetThePieces.Name: Set the Pieces
SetThePieces.Story: “Everyone up. We do this again, together.”
SetThePieces.Effect_before0000000000: Each target [[/surge 2]], can spend a Recovery, ends any conditions or effects on themselves, and stands up if prone.

BreakTheirNerve.Name: Break Their Nerve
BreakTheirNerve.Story: The instant a whole line of enemies decides, all at once, that this fight isn’t worth it.
BreakTheirNerve.Tier1: Frightened of you until the end of its next turn.
BreakTheirNerve.Tier3: Frightened of you (save ends) and weakened (save ends).

TotalCommand.Name: Total Command
TotalCommand.Story: Everyone acts NOW: the fight is decided in this instant.
TotalCommand.Effect_before0000000000: Each target [[/surge 1]] and can use a signature ability as a free triggered action. That ability gains an edge on its power roll, and any potency it has increases by 1.

CoupDeGrace.Name: Coup de Grâce
CoupDeGrace.Story: The moment that ends the fight, or the negotiation, permanently.
CoupDeGrace.Trigger: Combat: the target is not a leader or solo creature, and becomes winded. Social: an argument reaches its final phase.
CoupDeGrace.Effect_before0000000000:
Combat: the target is killed, and the creature who caused the target to be winded can spend a Recovery.

Social: force an immediate resolution in your favor: the NPC concedes fully, or walks away with your key demand met.

MarshalTheNetwork.Name: Marshal the Network
MarshalTheNetwork.Story: The web of people you’ve cultivated pays off exactly when you need it most.
MarshalTheNetwork.Effect_before0000000000:
Distance: In-scene or between scenes.

Call in a network favor: a Contact from your web arrives to help in this scene. What they can do depends on the Contact’s standing (Director-adjudicated, per the Contacts rules). You can call on each Contact this way only once per session.

SpeakWithOneVoice.Name: Speak With One Voice
SpeakWithOneVoice.Story: Riots, rallies, panic-quells, and mass loyalty pledges, all turning on the sound of your voice.
SpeakWithOneVoice.Effect_before0000000000:
Distance: Social scene.

You impose your framing on an entire crowd, faction, or room.
SpeakWithOneVoice.Tier1: Only the leader shifts Attitude one step toward Cooperative.
SpeakWithOneVoice.Tier2: Half of the present NPCs (the leader’s choice of who holds out) shift Attitude one step toward Cooperative.
SpeakWithOneVoice.Tier3: Every present NPC shifts Attitude one step toward Cooperative.

StreetFixer.Name: Street-Fixer
StreetFixer.Description:
“Deniable-ops undercity operator.” The whole undercity on speed-dial: deals, favors, and the fixer’s web. Corp cover: “independent contractor” or “unlicensed logistics.” You chrome up for utility, not showmanship.

At 1st level you gain the Streetwise skill, the Fixer’s Web feature, and the Advanced Tactics and Undercity Whisper triggered actions. You start with a fixer or gang lieutenant contact.

FixersWeb.Name: The Fixer’s Web
FixersWeb.Description:
You run the strongest contact web in the game: you start with extra contacts, cultivate them faster, and can call favors mid-run (see the Followers, Strongholds & Contacts rules). You gain an edge on Streetwise legwork and on negotiations framed around Freedom, Greed, or Vengeance.

While in your presence or working according to your plans, each ally gains an edge on intrigue tests (Stealth, Deception, Streetwise, Security Systems, and the like). You can use the Command skill to assist another creature with any intrigue test, and at the Director’s discretion you and your allies can use intrigue tests to attempt research or reconnaissance during a negotiation.

InfiltrationTactics.Name: Infiltration Tactics
InfiltrationTactics.Description: Whenever you or any ally within 10 squares of you becomes hidden, that creature [[/surge 1]].

GreyMarketAccess.Name: Grey Market Access
GreyMarketAccess.Description: Once per session, you can call in one gear item from your Fixer’s Web at half price.

Distracted.Name: Distracted
Distracted.Description: Creatures Marked by you don’t count as observers for the purpose of hiding. Additionally, you and your allies can use each other as cover when hiding.

LeaveNoTrace.Name: Leave No Trace
LeaveNoTrace.Description: You and allies within 10 squares of you can move at full speed while sneaking. Enemies within 10 squares of you take a bane on tests made to search for hidden creatures.

UndercityAdvantage.Name: Undercity Advantage
UndercityAdvantage.Description: During a montage test or a negotiation, you can automatically succeed on one intrigue test (Stealth, Deception, Streetwise, Security Systems, and the like). Additionally, you know how to conceal large groups of people, such as escapees or civilians, from pursuit.

SetUpThePlay.Name: Set Up the Play
SetUpThePlay.Description: Whenever you or any ally makes a strike against a creature Marked by you, you can spend 2 Influence to let the striker shift up to [[lookup @P]]{your Persona score} squares and use the Hide maneuver as a free maneuver during the shift. The shift can happen before or after the strike.

AdvancedTactics.Name: Advanced Tactics
AdvancedTactics.Story: Your leadership turns an ally’s hit into something more.
AdvancedTactics.Trigger: The target deals damage to a creature Marked by you.
AdvancedTactics.Effect_before0000000000: The target [[/surge 2]], which they can use on the triggering damage.
AdvancedTactics.Effect_spend00000000000: If the damage has any potency effect associated with it, the potency increases by 1.

UndercityWhisper.Name: Undercity Whisper
UndercityWhisper.Story: Somebody in your web always knows somebody.
UndercityWhisper.Trigger: A creature Marked by you, or an NPC Read by you, is affected by one of your abilities.
UndercityWhisper.Effect_before0000000000:
Distance: Any.

Once per encounter, you can spend 1 Influence to declare that a contact from your Fixer’s Web has intel on the target. You automatically learn the target’s Motivation.

FogOfWar.Name: Fog of War
FogOfWar.Story: Smoke, jammed feeds, crowd noise: nobody sees the crew clearly.
FogOfWar.Effect_before0000000000: You create a zone of confusion (smoke, jammed feeds, crowd noise). Until the end of the encounter, you and your allies have concealment while in the area, and enemies take a bane on Perception-based tests made within it.

TryMeInstead.Name: Try Me Instead
TryMeInstead.Story: You step into the line of fire and dare them.
TryMeInstead.Trigger: An enemy makes an attack that targets an ally within 10 squares of you.
TryMeInstead.Effect_before0000000000: You become the target of the triggering attack instead.

CoordinatedExecution.Name: Coordinated Execution
CoordinatedExecution.Effect_before0000000000: Once per encounter. The target must be Marked by you. You and up to 2 allies within 10 squares of the target can each make a free strike against it.

PanicInTheirLines.Name: Panic in Their Lines
PanicInTheirLines.Story: They watched their best go down, and now they don’t want to be next.
PanicInTheirLines.Effect_before0000000000: Until the end of the encounter, whenever a creature Marked by you takes damage from you or an ally, each enemy within 10 squares of it that can see it is [[/apply frightened save]]{frightened} (save ends).

SquadHitAndRun.Name: Squad! Hit and Run!
SquadHitAndRun.Story: Strike and gone before they turn.
SquadHitAndRun.Effect_before0000000000: Until the end of the encounter, whenever you or an ally within 10 squares of you resolves a strike against a creature Marked by you, that creature can immediately shift up to their speed (no action required).

TheirLackOfFocus.Name: Their Lack of Focus Is Their Undoing
TheirLackOfFocus.Story: Every missed shot tells you where they’ll be next.
TheirLackOfFocus.Effect_before0000000000: Until the end of the encounter, whenever an enemy ends its turn without damaging you or an ally within 10 squares of you, you and that ally gain an edge on your next power rolls against that enemy.

CorpExec.Name: Corp-Exec
CorpExec.Description:
“Boardroom strategist.” Credentials, protocol, and the weight of institutional power: you walk into the arcology like you own a floor of it. Corp cover: “executive liaison” or “corporate handler.” Your chrome is clean and soft — vocal modulators and diagnostic implants, nothing that reads as augmented in a boardroom.

At 1st level you gain the Corporate skill, the Credentials & Protocol feature, and the Overwatch and The Board Reads triggered actions. You start with a corp insider or handler contact.

CredentialsAndProtocol.Name: Credentials & Protocol
CredentialsAndProtocol.Description:
You carry plausible authority for access, clearance, and hierarchy. You gain an edge on tests to command NPCs who respect hierarchy, and on negotiations framed around Higher Authority or Greed.

Research projects about war, security operations, or corporate conflict are one category cheaper for you, and during a respite you can research an upcoming encounter you know about.

Goaded.Name: Goaded
Goaded.Description: Whenever a creature Marked by you uses a strike that targets you or an ally in your line of effect, you can use a free triggered action to change one target of that strike to you or another ally within the strike’s distance and your line of effect.

AccessProtocol.Name: Access Protocol
AccessProtocol.Description: Pre-run legwork: at the start of each session, name a corp faction. You gain a one-step Renown bump toward that faction for the session.

Anticipation.Name: Anticipation
Anticipation.Description: Your Mark ability can target two creatures at once, and both are Marked by you.

IPredictedThat.Name: I Predicted That
IPredictedThat.Description: You and each ally within 10 squares of you gain an edge on Logic tests.

TheBigPicture.Name: The Big Picture
TheBigPicture.Description: During a montage test or a negotiation, you can automatically succeed on one knowledge test. Additionally, during a respite you can make a project roll for a research project in addition to taking another respite activity.

ExecutivePlay.Name: Executive Play
ExecutivePlay.Description: Whenever you or any ally strikes a creature Marked by you, you can spend 2 Influence to let the striker shift up to [[lookup @P]]{your Persona score} squares before the strike. If you didn’t make the strike, you can also shift up to [[lookup @P]]{your Persona score} squares. If you made the strike, one ally within 10 squares of you can also shift up to [[lookup @P]]{your Persona score} squares.

Overwatch.Name: Overwatch
Overwatch.Story: You saw the move before they made it, and someone is already waiting.
Overwatch.Trigger: A creature Marked by you moves.
Overwatch.Effect_before0000000000: At any point during the target’s movement, one ally can make a free strike against it.
Overwatch.Effect_spend00000000000: If the target has a Reflex score lower than average, it is also [[/apply slowed turn]]{slowed} until the end of its turn.

TheBoardReads.Name: The Board Reads
TheBoardReads.Story: Titles, org charts, and who actually holds the knife.
TheBoardReads.Trigger: You succeed on a Read the Room against an NPC with corp authority.
TheBoardReads.Effect_before0000000000:
Distance: Social scene.

You learn the NPC’s corp faction and that faction’s current Renown standing toward your crew, and you [[/gain 1 hr]]{gain 1 Influence}.

IveGotYourBack.Name: I’ve Got Your Back
IveGotYourBack.Story: The contingency plan was always you.
IveGotYourBack.Effect_before0000000000: The target gains damage immunity equal to [[lookup @P]]{your Persona score} against the triggering damage.

TargetsOfOpportunity.Name: Targets of Opportunity
TargetsOfOpportunity.Story: You flag the target, and the crew is already moving.
TargetsOfOpportunity.Trigger: An enemy becomes Marked by you.
TargetsOfOpportunity.Effect_before0000000000: One ally within 10 squares who hasn’t acted yet this round can immediately make a free strike against the Marked enemy.

BattlePlan.Name: Battle Plan
BattlePlan.Story: The deck was printed before anyone walked into the room.
BattlePlan.Effect_before0000000000: Designate a plan: name one action (for example, “focus the sniper,” “hold the door,” “get the package out”). The first time each ally takes that action this encounter, they gain an edge on the power roll it involves.

Hustle.Name: Hustle!
Hustle.Effect_before0000000000: Each target can shift up to their speed (no action required).

BlotOutTheSun.Name: Blot Out the Sun!
BlotOutTheSun.Story: Every gun they have, pointed at the wrong problem.
BlotOutTheSun.Effect_before0000000000:
Distance: 5 burst centered on a creature Marked by you.

Each enemy in a 5 burst centered on a creature Marked by you takes a bane on power rolls against you and your allies until the end of the encounter.

Counterstrategy.Name: Counterstrategy
Counterstrategy.Story: You planned for this exact play.
Counterstrategy.Trigger: An enemy’s ability would affect 3 or more of your allies.
Counterstrategy.Effect_before0000000000: Once per encounter. The ability affects only one of those allies (your choice); it has no effect on the others.

Bard.Name: Bard
Bard.Description:
“Techno-performer.” A techno-musician, media personality, streaming presence, holo-performer, augmented vocal artist, and deepfake-charisma specialist whose spectacle carries the crew. The Bard is fully mundane: no Veil, no half-caster lane, and no magic-erosion penalty. Augmented vocal cords, subdermal light-rigs, and streaming implants are all on-brand. Corp cover: “media talent” or “content producer.”

At 1st level you gain the Performance skill, the Resonant Performance feature, and the Deflect the Beat and Riff on the Room triggered actions. You start with a promoter, journalist, streamer, or scene-fixer contact.

ResonantPerformance.Name: Resonant Performance
ResonantPerformance.Description:
Your performances — music, oratory, streaming, holo-work, augmented vocal work, deepfake charisma — inspire allies and sway crowds. You gain an edge on Performance tests and on tests to influence a crowd or mass audience.

During a negotiation, each hero with you treats their Renown as 2 higher. During combat, you gain a double edge on tests made to stop combat and start a negotiation.

CommandTheStage.Name: Command the Stage
CommandTheStage.Description:
Whenever you make an opportunity attack against a creature, that creature’s speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn.

Additionally, whenever a creature Marked by you attempts to move or shift while within distance of your melee free strike, you can use a free triggered action and spend 2 Influence to make a melee free strike against it.

TheSignatureBeat.Name: The Signature Beat
TheSignatureBeat.Description: You have a signature performance: a song, a slogan, a catchphrase, a media hook. When you perform it, each ally within 10 squares of you gains an edge on Instinct-based tests to read people and situations for the rest of the scene.

ShakeItOff.Name: Shake It Off
ShakeItOff.Description: As a free maneuver, you can take [[/damage 1d6]]{1d6 damage} that can’t be reduced in any way to ignore the consequence of a failed test, or to end one effect on you that is ended by a saving throw or that ends at the end of your turn. Each adjacent ally can do the same.

SetTheBeat.Name: Set the Beat
SetTheBeat.Description: Whenever you use the Charge main action against a creature Marked by you, you can use a signature or heroic ability that is a strike instead of a free strike.

TheShow.Name: The Show
TheShow.Description: During a montage test or a negotiation, you can automatically succeed on one social test. Additionally, during a respite you can convince a group of people to help with a crafting or social project.

BringTheHouseDown.Name: Bring the House Down
BringTheHouseDown.Description: Whenever you or an ally makes a melee strike against a creature Marked by you, you can spend 2 Influence to let the striker push the target up to [[lookup @P]]{your Persona score} squares, then shift up to [[lookup @P]]{your Persona score} squares, ending adjacent to the target.

DeflectTheBeat.Name: Deflect the Beat
DeflectTheBeat.Story: You move with the hit like it’s a downbeat, and it lands on nothing.
DeflectTheBeat.Trigger: A creature deals damage to the target.
DeflectTheBeat.Effect_before0000000000: You can shift 1 square. If the target is you, or if you end this shift adjacent to the target, the target takes half the damage. If the damage has any potency effect associated with it, the potency decreases by 1.
DeflectTheBeat.Effect_spend00000000000: This ability’s distance becomes Melee [[lookup 1+@P evaluate]]{1 + your Persona score}, and you can shift up to [[lookup @P]]{your Persona score} squares instead of 1.

RiffOnTheRoom.Name: Riff on the Room
RiffOnTheRoom.Story: The crowd leans in, and you ride it.
RiffOnTheRoom.Trigger: The room’s mood swings your way: any Attitude shifts toward Cooperative, or an ally gets a high (17+) result on a Performance or social test.

NoDyingOnMyWatch.Name: No Dying on My Watch
NoDyingOnMyWatch.Story: Not tonight. Not on your stage.
NoDyingOnMyWatch.Trigger: The target would be reduced to 0 Stamina.
NoDyingOnMyWatch.Effect_before0000000000: Before the damage resolves, the target gains temporary Stamina equal to [[lookup @P]]{your Persona score}.

SquadOnMe.Name: Squad! On Me!
SquadOnMe.Effect_before0000000000: Each target is pulled to an unoccupied square adjacent to you (no action required for them).

InstantRetaliation.Name: Instant Retaliation
InstantRetaliation.Story: Heckle the headliner, get the mic in your teeth.
InstantRetaliation.Trigger: A creature Marked by you deals damage to you.
InstantRetaliation.Effect_before0000000000: You make a melee free strike against the target.

ToMeSquad.Name: To Me Squad!
ToMeSquad.Story: The light-rig flares, and the crew is simply there.
ToMeSquad.Effect_before0000000000: Each target is teleported to an unoccupied square adjacent to you.

NoEscape.Name: No Escape
NoEscape.Story: Nobody walks out on the show.
NoEscape.Effect_before0000000000: Until the end of the encounter, whenever a creature Marked by you willingly moves away from you or one of your allies, the nearest ally can make a free strike against it.

ThatOneIsMine.Name: That One Is Mine!
ThatOneIsMine.Story: Center stage. Just the two of you.
ThatOneIsMine.Effect_before0000000000: Once per encounter. The target must be Marked by you. Until the end of the encounter, you have a double edge on power rolls against the target, and the target has a bane on power rolls against creatures other than you.

Class.Name: Medic
Class.Description:
You are a Medic — on the street the doc, the sawbones, the fixer’s fixer, or simply the one who keeps you breathing. Corp paperwork files you as a “field medical contractor” or a “trauma-response asset.” You are a trained practitioner of medicine and chemistry who carries syringes, trauma patches, gas grenades, combat stims, and brewed compounds into places where the nearest hospital is a rumor.

You are the only flesh-and-blood healer of living heroes in the Reach — healing, curing poison and disease, and neutralizing toxins by chemistry alone. Your chemistry cuts both ways: the same kit that stims a friend can gas a room full of hostiles. You are fully mundane and chrome-positive; any People, Cyborgs included, can carry the bag.

Your heroic resource is Reagents: a physical kit you fill at a respite and spend down across a whole run. Reagents don’t reset between encounters and don’t refill on their own. Kit capacity is 10 Reagents at Echelon 1, 14 at Echelon 2, 20 at Echelon 3, and 38 at Echelon 4.

Your subclass is your specialization: Street-Doc, Corp-Medtech, or Ripperdoc.

Core characteristics: Instinct, Logic · Heroic resource: Reagents · Starting Stamina: 18 (+6 per level) · Recoveries: 8 · Kit: yes (light Kits, or a combat-medic medium Kit). Quick Build: Street-Doc, Gunslinger.

Reagents.Name: Reagents
Reagents.Description:
Reagents are your kit, literally: trauma patches, syringes, antitoxin vials, gas canisters, stim injectors, and the raw chemical stock to brew more. Every heroic ability and every signature enhancement spends Reagents.

Kit Capacity

EchelonKit capacity
110
214
320
438

Advanced Chem-Prep (2nd level) adds 2 to your capacity. You can never hold more Reagents than your capacity.

Reagents Persist

Unlike every other class’s heroic resource, Reagents don’t reset at the start or end of an encounter, and you gain none at the start of your turns. The bag you bring is the bag you have: unspent Reagents carry from fight to fight across a run.

A basic compound or a signature enhancement usually costs 2 Reagents, one dose. At Echelon 1 that is five doses before the bag runs dry. When it’s empty, you still have Established Protocols and (from 2nd level) Field Synthesis.

Restocking

At a respite, or during downtime, you restock up to your kit capacity. Restocking is a project or lifestyle activity paid in nuyen (buying raw stock, calling a supplier, or synthesizing from scratch). Money buys supply, never capability: nuyen refills the bag, but never unlocks a compound or a feature.

Outside of Combat

Reagents are a physical kit, so they still spend outside combat. Unlike other classes’ heroic resources, you get no free out-of-combat uses of Reagent abilities or signature enhancements: every dose comes out of the same bag.

  • Established Protocols stay free at all times.

  • Field Synthesis is encounter-only: it isn’t a free compound between encounters or in downtime.

Compound Families

  • Restoratives heal [[lookup @recoveries.recoveryValue]]{your Recovery value} in Stamina (enhanced, +50% rounded up), stabilize the dying, and revive the downed.

  • Antidotes & Cures remove 1 step of poison, disease, or the Exposure clock (enhanced, 2 steps).

  • Stimulants & Combat Drugs grant an edge or let the target ignore 1 condition for 1 round (enhanced, +1 round or +1 ally). Every Stimulant carries the crash rider: −1 on the recipient’s next power roll after the buff ends (−2 if enhanced), automatic, no save.

  • Toxins & Gas deal 2 + Instinct damage over 2 rounds (half each round, rounding up on the first tick), and the target is weakened until the end of its next turn after the last tick. Enhanced: 4 + Instinct over 2 rounds, and the target is weakened and slowed.

In Foundry, Reagents are your heroic resource pool: Draw Steel doesn’t reset them when combat starts and adds nothing at the start of your turns. Capacity isn’t enforced; set your pool when you restock. You can’t use an ability that costs more Reagents than you have, in or out of combat.

FieldPartner.Name: Field Partner
FieldPartner.Description: At the start of each encounter, bond with one ally. Until the end of the encounter, that ally gains an edge on saving throws and +1 to any healing you apply to them, and whenever one of your abilities heals that ally, you [[/gain 1 hr]]{regain 1 Reagent}.

EstablishedProtocols.Name: Established Protocols
EstablishedProtocols.Description:
Two rote procedures you can perform at will, with no Reagent cost and no roll:

  • Stabilize: stabilize an adjacent ally who is dying at 0 Stamina or lower.

  • Identify: identify a substance or toxin at a glance.

This is the floor you never fall below, even with an empty kit.

AdvancedChemPrep.Name: Advanced Chem-Prep
AdvancedChemPrep.Description: Your kit capacity increases by 2 (Echelon 1: 12, Echelon 2: 16, Echelon 3: 22, Echelon 4: 40).

CompoundMastery.Name: Compound Mastery
CompoundMastery.Description: Choose one compound family: Restoratives, Antidotes & Cures, Stimulants & Combat Drugs, or Toxins & Gas. Compounds you produce from that family are automatically enhanced at no extra Reagent cost. (An enhanced Stimulant still carries the enhanced crash rider.)

FieldReputation.Name: Field Reputation
FieldReputation.Description: You gain a Renown boost among street clinics or corp-med circles (whichever fits your specialization’s social lane), and a narrative foothold with the local medical infrastructure: a clinic that will take your patients, a pharmacist who picks up.

EmergencyPriority.Name: Emergency Priority
EmergencyPriority.Description: Once per session, on your first turn of an encounter, you can use one ability without paying its Reagent cost.

ColleagueAndMentor.Name: Colleague & Mentor
ColleagueAndMentor.Description: You gain a bonus contact from the medical world. Additionally, you gain an edge on tests made to teach a skill to an ally during downtime.

CrossTrained.Name: Cross-Trained
CrossTrained.Description: When you finish a respite, you can swap one of your skills for a related skill, reflecting how a working Medic’s practical education keeps shifting with the jobs they take.

BattlefieldRenown.Name: Battlefield Renown
BattlefieldRenown.Description: Whenever you use Miracle Worker or Triage, each ally gains an edge on their next power roll: the crew rallies visibly the moment the doc goes to work.

Reputation.Name: Reputation
Reputation.Description: At the start of each encounter, you gain bonus Reagents equal to [[lookup @hero.victories]]{your Victories}, up to your kit capacity.

MasterChemist.Name: Master Chemist
MasterChemist.Description: Your epic capstone, Master Chemist: every compound you produce is automatically enhanced, without spending the extra Reagents an enhancement normally costs. Enhanced Stimulants still carry the enhanced crash rider.

LegendOfTheStreet.Name: Legend of the Street
LegendOfTheStreet.Description: Once per session, you can perform one impossible feat of medicine — narrative in scope and adjudicated by the Director. It’s the Medic’s answer to “surely that shouldn’t be possible.”

FirstAid.Name: First Aid
FirstAid.Story: Someone’s bleeding and there’s no time to think.
FirstAid.Effect_before0000000000: You can use this ability as a maneuver for a quick patch. The target must be a living creature. Add your Medicine skill to the roll if you have it.
FirstAid.Effect_spend00000000000: Apply a full Restorative instead: the heal increases by 50% (round up) for each 2 Reagents spent, or you revive a downed ally to their feet, or the distance becomes Ranged 5 (a thrown patch or injector).
FirstAid.Tier1: A small patch: the target stabilizes if dying, without healing.
FirstAid.Tier2: The target heals Stamina equal to your Recovery value.
FirstAid.Tier3: The target heals Stamina equal to your Recovery value and ends one bleeding or dazed condition.

AdministerDose.Name: Administer Dose
AdministerDose.Story: The same injector saves your friend’s life or ends your enemy’s.
AdministerDose.Effect_before0000000000:
What’s loaded in the injector depends on the target.

  • Ally (Stimulant, no roll): the target gains an edge on power rolls, or ignores one condition, for 1 round.

  • Enemy (Toxin, power roll): the target takes [[lookup 2+@I evaluate]]{2 + Instinct} damage over 2 rounds (half each round, rounding up on the first tick) and is weakened until the end of its next turn after the last tick.

Crash rider (automatic): when the buff ends, each recipient takes −1 on their power rolls for 1 round (−2 for 2 rounds if the dose was enhanced). No save, no opt-out.
AdministerDose.Effect_spend00000000000: A stronger dose: for each 2 Reagents spent, the Stimulant lasts 1 more round, the Toxin becomes [[lookup 4+@I evaluate]]{4 + Instinct} damage over 2 rounds and also slows the target, or you dose one additional target.

Diagnose.Name: Diagnose
Diagnose.Story: A Medic reads a body the way a Hacker reads a network.
Diagnose.Effect_before0000000000:
Distance: Sight.

You read the target’s condition: remaining Stamina, active conditions, poisons, diseases, and weaknesses.
Diagnose.Effect_spend00000000000: Read multiple targets with the same maneuver, or the crew-wide edge lasts until the end of the encounter.
Diagnose.Tier1: A partial read: you learn roughly how much Stamina the target has left (unhurt, winded, or near death).
Diagnose.Tier2: You learn the target’s conditions and one weakness.
Diagnose.Tier3: A full read, and you and each ally gain an edge on power rolls against the target for 1 round.

EmergencyPatch.Name: Emergency Patch
EmergencyPatch.Effect_before0000000000: The target heals Stamina equal to half your Recovery value ([[/heal floor(@recoveries.recoveryValue/2)]]), and if they are bleeding, the bleeding ends.

SlapInjector.Name: Slap-Injector
SlapInjector.Story: Quick, cheap, and gentle enough that it doesn’t tax the recipient.
SlapInjector.Effect_before0000000000: Choose one: the target can make a saving throw against one active effect that a save can end, or the target gains an edge on their next power roll. This is a mild stim: no crash rider.

CombatStims.Name: Combat Stims
CombatStims.Story: Hard combat drugs that turn a fight around, at an honest cost.
CombatStims.Effect_before0000000000:
For 1 round, each target gains an extra maneuver this turn, an edge on their next power roll, and [[/heal @recoveries.recoveryValue temp]]{temporary Stamina equal to your Recovery value}.

Crash rider (automatic): when the buff ends, each recipient takes −1 on their power rolls for 1 round (−2 for 2 rounds if the dose was enhanced). No save, no opt-out.

ToxicCloud.Name: Toxic Cloud
ToxicCloud.Story: The same chemistry that saves lives, weaponized into a room nobody wants to stand in.
ToxicCloud.Effect_before0000000000: You deploy a gas cloud. Each enemy in the area takes the base Toxin dose: [[lookup 2+@I evaluate]]{2 + Instinct} damage over 2 rounds (half each round, rounding up on the first tick), and it is weakened until the end of its next turn after the last tick. The area stays hazardous for those 2 rounds: an enemy that enters it or starts its turn there suffers the effect again.

RapidFieldDiagnosis.Name: Rapid Field Diagnosis
RapidFieldDiagnosis.Story: The intel signature, scaled up to a whole engagement.
RapidFieldDiagnosis.Effect_before0000000000: You Diagnose every enemy in the area at once (as a high result on Diagnose, without the edge). You and each ally gain an edge on power rolls against those enemies for 1 round.

BloodDoping.Name: Blood Doping
BloodDoping.Story: A pre-emptive hedge for the ally about to walk into the worst of it.
BloodDoping.Effect_before0000000000: For 1 round, the target has damage immunity 5. The target also gains [[/heal @recoveries.recoveryValue temp]]{temporary Stamina equal to your Recovery value}.

Triage.Name: Triage
Triage.Story: A burst of field medicine across the whole crew at once.
Triage.Effect_before0000000000: Each target heals Stamina equal to your Recovery value ([[/heal @recoveries.recoveryValue]]), stabilizes if dying, and ends one condition or poison on themselves.

PurgeToxins.Name: Purge Toxins
PurgeToxins.Story: For a target who’s taken on more toxin than a single dose can clear.
PurgeToxins.Effect_before0000000000: The target is cleared of all poisons, diseases, and Exposure-clock steps.

FocusSerum.Name: Focus Serum
FocusSerum.Effect_before0000000000:
Each target gains an edge on power rolls for 1 round.

Crash rider (automatic): when the buff ends, each target takes −1 on their power rolls for 1 round. No save, no opt-out.

Anesthetize.Name: Anesthetize
Anesthetize.Story: The anesthetic that puts a patient under safely can put an enemy down hard.
Anesthetize.Tier1: The target is dazed until the end of its next turn.
Anesthetize.Tier3: The target falls unconscious: it’s out of the fight until the end of its next turn, or until it takes damage (Director’s call which).

MiracleWorker.Name: Miracle Worker
MiracleWorker.Story: Impossible skill and the right compound at the right second. No magic anywhere.
MiracleWorker.Effect_before0000000000:
No roll. Choose exactly one effect; they don’t stack.

  • Full revive: an ally within 10 squares who is dying, or who died within the last round, is revived at 1 Stamina.

  • Total purge: end all toxins, diseases, and conditions on one target.

  • Massive heal: one ally heals Stamina equal to three times your Recovery value ([[/heal 3*@recoveries.recoveryValue]]).

A purge clears toxins, diseases, and conditions only. It doesn’t regrow a limb, undo a permanent injury, or restore lost Body Integrity.

NerveToxin.Name: Nerve Toxin
NerveToxin.Story: For the thing that really needs to go down slowly and stay down.
NerveToxin.Effect_before0000000000: The target takes [[lookup 6+@I evaluate]]{6 + Instinct} damage over 3 rounds (equal ticks, rounding up on earlier ticks) and is slowed and weakened for the full duration.

ChemicalInterrogation.Name: Chemical Interrogation
ChemicalInterrogation.Story: Interrogation that doesn’t require a fist.
ChemicalInterrogation.Effect_before0000000000: No roll (for a resistant target, the Director can call for a contested test: your Instinct against the target’s Physique). For 3 rounds, the target answers questions truthfully. In combat, it reveals one piece of intel of your choice.

FieldAdrenal.Name: Field Adrenal
FieldAdrenal.Story: A full extra turn, paid for with the harshest standard crash in the class.
FieldAdrenal.Effect_before0000000000:
You and up to 2 adjacent allies each gain an extra main action, maneuver, and move action this turn.

Crash rider (automatic, enhanced): each recipient takes −2 on their power rolls for 2 rounds after the buff ends.

ChemicalWarfare.Name: Chemical Warfare
ChemicalWarfare.Effect_before0000000000: A massive gas cloud fills the area for 3 rounds. Each enemy in it takes damage over time and is weakened and slowed while inside. The area is hazardous terrain for the full duration.

EmergencyTransfusion.Name: Emergency Transfusion
EmergencyTransfusion.Story: Pull the whole crew back from the brink at once.
EmergencyTransfusion.Effect_before0000000000: Each target heals Stamina equal to your Recovery value ([[/heal @recoveries.recoveryValue]]). Each dying target stabilizes, and each target who died within the last round revives at 1 Stamina.

PerfectDiagnosis.Name: Perfect Diagnosis
PerfectDiagnosis.Story: The intel play that changes the whole fight’s math.
PerfectDiagnosis.Effect_before0000000000: You and each ally gain an edge on power rolls against every enemy within distance for 3 rounds. You also learn additional tactical information about the strongest enemy present.

BattlefieldSurgery.Name: Battlefield Surgery
BattlefieldSurgery.Effect_before0000000000: The target heals Stamina equal to five times your Recovery value ([[/heal 5*@recoveries.recoveryValue]]), and all conditions and toxins on them end. The target has damage immunity 5 against the next 3 strikes made against them.

WonderDrug.Name: Wonder Drug
WonderDrug.Story: An encounter-spanning cocktail with a cost that follows everyone into what comes next.
WonderDrug.Effect_before0000000000:
Until the end of the encounter, you and each ally within distance gain an edge on power rolls and an extra maneuver on each of your turns, and each gains [[/heal @recoveries.recoveryValue temp]]{temporary Stamina equal to your Recovery value}.

Crash rider (automatic, enhanced): at the end of the encounter, each recipient takes −2 on the first power roll of the next scene.

NerveAgent.Name: Nerve Agent
NerveAgent.Story: The compound that ends fights by itself.
NerveAgent.Effect_before0000000000:
Distance: The battlefield (Director sets the exact area).

Each enemy in the area makes a saving throw; on a failure, it is weakened and slowed (save ends). Every enemy in the area takes [[lookup 6+@I evaluate]]{6 + Instinct} damage over 3 rounds (equal ticks, rounding up on earlier ticks), whether or not it failed the save.

FullKitPurge.Name: Full Kit Purge
FullKitPurge.Story: Everything, everywhere, all at once — and nothing left for the rest of the run.
FullKitPurge.Effect_before0000000000: You spend all remaining Reagents in your kit (minimum 11). At the minimum 11-Reagent spend, each target gets what The Doctor Is In delivers: heals Recovery value × 2, has all conditions cleared, and revives if dying or dead (within the Director’s freshly-killed line). Your kit is empty afterward.
FullKitPurge.Effect_spend00000000000: Every Reagent beyond 11 adds +1 Recovery value of healing to each target.

TheDoctorIsIn.Name: The Doctor Is In
TheDoctorIsIn.Story: The moment the whole crew gets to stand back up at once.
TheDoctorIsIn.Effect_before0000000000: Each ally within distance heals Stamina equal to twice your Recovery value ([[/heal 2*@recoveries.recoveryValue]]), ends all conditions on themselves, and revives if dying or if they died within the last round. Each also gains [[/heal @recoveries.recoveryValue temp]]{temporary Stamina equal to your Recovery value}.

FieldSynthesis.Name: Field Synthesis
FieldSynthesis.Story: A stripped first-aid kit off a downed enemy, spare stock jury-rigged into something usable.
FieldSynthesis.Effect_before0000000000:
Once per encounter (Street-Doc: twice), you produce a half-strength compound (Street-Doc: two-thirds strength) for 0 Reagents, from any of the four families:

  • Restorative: heal half your Recovery value in Stamina ([[/heal floor(@recoveries.recoveryValue/2)]]).

  • Antidote: suppress one step of a poison, disease, or Exposure-clock effect until the end of the encounter (Director’s call on whether it clears fully).

  • Stimulant: an edge on the target’s next power roll only. Crash rider: −1 on their power roll after that.

  • Toxin: half the base Toxin damage (half of 2 + Instinct) over 2 rounds, and the target is weakened until the end of its next turn after the last tick.

Field Synthesis can’t be enhanced.

StreetDoc.Name: Street-Doc
StreetDoc.Description:
“Back-alley generalist.” The scrappy, improvisational medic who’s kept half the neighborhood alive without ever seeing the inside of a licensed clinic. You have the best kit economy of the three: you stretch Reagents further and recover faster from running dry. Corp cover: “unlicensed neighborhood doctor” or “street medical services.” You chrome up for utility, not showmanship.

At 1st level you gain the Streetwise skill, the Make Do and Back-Alley Wits features, and the Improvise! triggered action. You have a fixer, ganger-clinic, or black-market-pharma contact.

MakeDo.Name: Make Do
MakeDo.Description: You improvise and restock faster and cheaper. Once you have Field Synthesis (2nd level), you can use it twice per encounter instead of once, and it produces a two-thirds-strength compound instead of half-strength.

BackAlleyWits.Name: Back-Alley Wits
BackAlleyWits.Description: You have an edge on First Aid when the target is below half their Stamina maximum.

ScroungersEye.Name: Scrounger’s Eye
ScroungersEye.Description: Once per respite, when you restock your kit, you can spend extra time (Director’s call on how long) to reduce the nuyen cost of a full refill by 25%.

BackAlleyNetwork.Name: Back-Alley Network
BackAlleyNetwork.Description: Choose one when you gain this feature: you gain a one-step Renown bump among street clinics, or you gain an edge on power rolls made with compounds from Field Synthesis.

NothingWasted.Name: Nothing Wasted
NothingWasted.Description: Once per encounter each, you can use Emergency Patch and Slap-Injector without spending Reagents (if you have them).

Improvise.Name: Improvise!
Improvise.Story: You found something in the trash.
Improvise.Trigger: Your kit has 3 or fewer Reagents remaining.
Improvise.Effect_before0000000000: Once per encounter, you [[/gain 2 hr]]{regain 2 Reagents}, up to your kit capacity.

TrashBinChemistry.Name: Trash-Bin Chemistry
TrashBinChemistry.Description: Field Synthesis can always produce a Toxin compound, even when the Director would otherwise limit what you can scrounge.

RegularCustomer.Name: Regular Customer
RegularCustomer.Description: You have a standing black-market-pharma contact who sells you Reagent restocks at a 15% discount.

BackAlleyMiracle.Name: Back-Alley Miracle
BackAlleyMiracle.Description: Once per encounter, Emergency Patch can target 2 allies instead of 1, at no additional Reagent cost.

FastHands.Name: Fast Hands
FastHands.Description: Once per round, you can use First Aid as a maneuver instead of a main action. First Aid used this way can’t be enhanced.

TheDocWhoNeverLeft.Name: The Doc Who Never Left
TheDocWhoNeverLeft.Description: Once per session, you can treat a failed restock (a nuyen shortfall, a supplier who didn’t show) as a success. You find a way, no questions asked.

LastSyringe.Name: Last Syringe
LastSyringe.Description: Once per session, when your kit is at 0 Reagents, you can produce one base (non-enhanced) compound for free.

CorpMedtech.Name: Corp-Medtech
CorpMedtech.Description:
“Clean professional.” The licensed, polished practitioner: better product, cleaner delivery, and a faster recovery from the crash rider than anyone else can manage. Corp cover: “licensed medical practitioner” or “pharmaceutical specialist.” Your chrome is clean, high-grade bioware and diagnostic implants.

At 1st level you gain the Corporate skill, the Pharmaceutical Grade and Licensed Protocol features, and the Clean Delivery triggered action. You have a corp-clinic, pharma-supplier, or medical-datahaus contact.

PharmaceuticalGrade.Name: Pharmaceutical Grade
PharmaceuticalGrade.Description:
When you produce a compound, choose one bonus: +50% base magnitude (round up), +1 round of buff duration, or +1 additional target.

The crash rider from any Stimulant you produce lasts 1 round less — an enhanced crash lasts 1 round instead of 2, and a base crash expires before it applies to a roll. It still happens, at the same −1/−2.

LicensedProtocol.Name: Licensed Protocol
LicensedProtocol.Description: Compounds from Combat Stims and Administer Dose last 1 additional round.

StandardizedDosing.Name: Standardized Dosing
StandardizedDosing.Description: Your Restorative and Antidote compounds never suffer improvisation penalties: the Director doesn’t reduce them for substandard equipment or conditions.

CorporateRequisition.Name: Corporate Requisition
CorporateRequisition.Description: Choose one when you gain this feature: you gain a one-step Renown bump among corp-med circles, or your next full kit refill costs 25% less nuyen.

PremiumStock.Name: Premium Stock
PremiumStock.Description: Once per encounter, you can apply Pharmaceutical Grade twice to a single compound, stacking the same bonus or choosing two different ones.

CleanDelivery.Name: Clean Delivery
CleanDelivery.Trigger: You use Administer Dose on a target within 3 squares of you.
CleanDelivery.Effect_before0000000000: Administer Dose gains one additional target within its distance, at no additional Reagent cost.

DatahausAccess.Name: Datahaus Access
DatahausAccess.Description: When you enhance Diagnose to grant a crew-wide edge, the edge lasts 1 additional round.

PharmaSupplier.Name: Pharma Supplier
PharmaSupplier.Description: You have a standing corp-clinic contact who sells you Reagent restocks at a 15% discount, with no black-market risk.

ReducedComedown.Name: Reduced Comedown
ReducedComedown.Description: The crash rider from compounds you produce never exceeds −1, even when the dose was enhanced.

BatchProcessing.Name: Batch Processing
BatchProcessing.Description: Triage can target up to 5 allies instead of 4, at no additional Reagent cost.

GoldStandardProtocol.Name: Gold-Standard Protocol
GoldStandardProtocol.Description: Once per session, you produce a compound with every Pharmaceutical Grade benefit at once (+50% magnitude, +1 round, and +1 target, plus the shorter crash), at no extra Reagent cost.

CrashProtocolOverride.Name: Crash Protocol Override
CrashProtocolOverride.Description: Once per session, you can waive the crash rider entirely on one Stimulant compound you produce.

Ripperdoc.Name: Ripperdoc
Ripperdoc.Description:
“Chrome surgeon.” The most chromed of the three specializations: a surgeon who installs and repairs implants as comfortably as setting a bone, and the only Medic with a self-revive capstone. Corp cover: “cybertech specialist” or “surgical prosthetics engineer.” Your implants are still fully mundane.

At 1st level you gain the Cybertech skill, the Under the Knife and Metal & Meat features, and the Cutter’s Reflex triggered action. You have a chop-shop, ripperdoc-network, or chrome-fence contact.

UnderTheKnife.Name: Under the Knife
UnderTheKnife.Description: You are a premier chrome installer and repairer. You gain an edge on downtime projects to install, repair, or remove chrome, with a reduced risk of botching them, and you have access to rarer implants. You can also work on the organic components of Cyborgs, which other Medics can’t.

MetalAndMeat.Name: Metal & Meat
MetalAndMeat.Description: You have an edge on First Aid and Diagnose against chrome-heavy creatures and partial Cyborgs.

SteadyHands.Name: Steady Hands
SteadyHands.Description: Your downtime projects to install, repair, or remove chrome take 25% less time.

ChopShopConnections.Name: Chop-Shop Connections
ChopShopConnections.Description: Choose one when you gain this feature: you gain a one-step Renown bump among ripperdoc networks, or you gain access to one rare or black-market implant per echelon at reduced nuyen cost.

CuttersReflex.Name: Cutter’s Reflex
CuttersReflex.Story: You know exactly where that implant takes the hit.
CuttersReflex.Trigger: An ally with 2 or more chrome pieces installed takes damage.
