CuttersReflex.Effect_before0000000000: Spend 1 Reagent: the target takes 5 less damage from the triggering damage (8 less with Chrome Whisperer).

NanoAdrenalAutoInjector.Name: Nano-Adrenal Auto-Injector
NanoAdrenalAutoInjector.Story: The surgeon is their own patient.
NanoAdrenalAutoInjector.Effect_before0000000000:
Once per session. Choose a payment: spend 30 Reagents from your kit (only if you have at least 30), or permanently lose 1 Body Integrity. At the start of your next turn, you revive at 1 Stamina.

The Body Integrity loss is permanent and doesn’t heal. This is the only self-revive in the Medic class.

ChromeWhisperer.Name: Chrome Whisperer
ChromeWhisperer.Description: Cutter’s Reflex reduces the damage by 8 instead of 5.

BlackMarketParts.Name: Black-Market Parts
BlackMarketParts.Description: You have a standing chop-shop or chrome-fence contact who sells rare implants with a reduced Availability restriction.

SurgicalPrecision.Name: Surgical Precision
SurgicalPrecision.Description: Once per encounter, when you use First Aid on a chrome-heavy creature or partial Cyborg, the power roll automatically counts as a high (17+) result.

OverclockProtocol.Name: Overclock Protocol
OverclockProtocol.Description: Once per encounter, you can give an ally with 2 or more chrome pieces the effect of Combat Stims, targeting only them, for 0 Reagents. The crash rider still applies.

TheWholePackage.Name: The Whole Package
TheWholePackage.Description: Once per session, during a respite, you give an ally a full chrome tune-up: they gain an edge on their first chrome-reliant power roll or test in the next encounter.

EmergencyExcision.Name: Emergency Excision
EmergencyExcision.Story: One cut, and the implant goes dark.
EmergencyExcision.Effect_before0000000000: Once per session. The target is an enemy you touch, or a willing ally. You disable one chrome implant of your choice on the target until their next respite. Body Integrity isn’t refunded mid-fight.

Class.Name: Wrench
Class.Description:
You are a Wrench — on the street the mechanic, or, if your fleet has a reputation, the warlord. You are the crew’s war machine: not a soldier and not a spellcaster, but an engineer who fights through a fielded force of drones, vehicles, and wired sites. You roll up to the run with a truck full of hardware, deploy it, and command a small mechanized army. Your body is often the least dangerous thing on the map, by design.

You are a street class. Nobody hands you a diploma for this: you learned in a salvage yard, off pirated firmware forums, hauling freight and modding the truck between runs, or fortifying a half-collapsed sub-level. A corp history, if you have one, is backstory only. No Wrench subclass is an academy.

Your heroic resource is Uptime: the runtime of your fielded fleet, earned while your machines are out and working, drained when they (or you) get hit, jammed, or wrecked, and spent to deploy, command, override, and burst-fire. Nuyen buys the hardware; Uptime runs it.

Your subclass is the role you grew into: Drone Jockey (the swarm), Vehicle Rig-Pilot (the driver), or Facility Rigger (the warlord).

Core characteristics: Logic, Reflex · Heroic resource: Uptime · Starting Stamina: 18 (+6 per level) · Recoveries: 8 · Kit: yes (light-to-moderate). Quick Build: Drone Jockey, Fabricator’s Bench.

Uptime.Name: Uptime
Uptime.Description:
Uptime is machine runtime: the bandwidth, focus, and signal integrity you have for commanding your fielded machines.

Earning Uptime

  • Roll-out: at the start of a combat encounter, you gain Uptime equal to [[lookup @hero.victories]]{your Victories}.

  • Fielded fleet: at the start of each of your turns, you gain 1 Uptime for each machine active and under your control. Foundry adds [[/gain 1 hr]]{1} automatically; add the rest for each additional active machine.

  • Deploy momentum: the first time each machine comes online in an encounter, [[/gain 2 hr]]{gain 2 Uptime}.

  • Maintenance tick: a successful Field Repair, or a successful save or test to keep a machine working under pressure, [[/gain 1 hr]]{gains 1 Uptime}.

  • Salvage tick: destroying an enemy machine, or stripping a wreck for parts as a maneuver, [[/gain 1 hr]]{gains 1 Uptime}.

  • First blood: the first damage a machine you control deals each encounter gains 1 Uptime.

  • Exposed target: whenever a machine you control damages a target another crew member has already marked, suppressed, or otherwise debuffed, gain 1 Uptime.

  • Reposition: whenever a machine you control repositions and then damages a target it ended adjacent to (or in its firing arc) this round, gain 1 Uptime.

Draining Uptime

  • Your body is hit while Jumped-In or otherwise engaged with the fleet: the feedback spike bleeds Uptime (Director’s call).

  • A machine you control takes a hit: lose 1 Uptime.

  • Signal jamming: an enemy electronic warfare pulse that jams or spoofs your link drains 2–4 Uptime.

  • A machine is wrecked (0 Integrity): lose 3 Uptime.

Spending and Limits

Deploy, Command, Override, and burst abilities cost Uptime. An Uptime ability that has an edge or double edge costs 1 fewer Uptime.

Uptime cap: 10 at 1st level, 12 at 5th level, 14 at 10th level. You can’t bank Uptime above your cap.

You lose any remaining Uptime at the end of the encounter. Outside combat you can’t gain Uptime, but you can use an Uptime ability without spending it; you can’t use that same ability outside combat again until you earn 1 or more Victories or finish a respite.

Firewall: nuyen buys machines, Uptime runs them. Chrome can make Uptime abilities more efficient, but never generates Uptime.

Uptime costs and numbers are v1 estimates pending calibration.

In Foundry, Uptime is your heroic resource: the automatic gain is a flat 1 per turn, and the cap isn’t enforced. Use the buttons above for the rest of the loop.

TheMachines.Name: Fleet & Jump-In
TheMachines.Description:
A table summary of THE MACHINES. Full drone, vehicle, and building catalogs live in the Drones and Vehicles chapters.

Machines

Every drone, vehicle, turret, and wired site asset has Integrity (0 = wrecked), Handling (an edge or bane on the controlling roll), Speed, Armor (flat damage reduction), a Control Mode (Autonomous, Commanded, or Jumped-In), and weapon or payload. Drones are Personal or Light scale; vehicles run Light to Capital.

Upgrade Slots (mods bought with nuyen): Micro drone 1, Small 2, Standard 3; Light vehicle 2, Vehicle 4, Heavy 6, Capital 8+. Bigger-scale attacks against smaller targets gain an edge and more damage; smaller against bigger take a bane and deal chip damage unless they use a called shot or a scale-appropriate weapon.

Machine conditions: Crippled (Handling/Speed penalty), Systems Down (a station offline), On Fire/Leaking (ongoing damage), Stalled/Dead-stick (immobilized).

Jump-In

As a maneuver, make a Logic or Reflex test (moderate difficulty, modified by Handling) to jack into a Jump-In-capable machine. On a success, your body is inert and exposed (biofeedback from machine damage can reach your Stamina), and you gain the machine’s Speed, a weapon-lock edge, and a temporary Integrity buffer of +4 (+5 from 6th level, +6 from 7th level). Damage to the machine drains your Uptime as usual. On a failure you can retry next turn; on a roll of 5 or lower you take 1 biofeedback damage. Leaving Jump-In is free at the start of your turn, or automatic if the machine is wrecked.

Uptime costs and numbers are v1 estimates pending calibration.

FleetSizeDoctrine.Name: Fleet Size Doctrine
FleetSizeDoctrine.Description:
You can have up to 3 machines active at once. This rises to 4 at 4th level, 5 at 7th level, and 6 at 10th level (Drone Jockeys raise it further). You can’t exceed the cap: to bring another machine online, stand one down first.

Fleet size is separate from your Uptime cap and from a machine’s Upgrade Slots.

Uptime costs and numbers are v1 estimates pending calibration.

FleetCap4.Name: Fleet Cap +1 (4)
FleetCap4.Description: Your fleet size cap increases to 4 machines.

FleetCap5.Name: Fleet Cap +1 (5)
FleetCap5.Description: Your fleet size cap increases to 5 machines.

JumpInBufferL6.Name: Jump-In Buffer Increase (+5)
JumpInBufferL6.Description: The temporary Integrity buffer you gain on a successful Jump-In increases from +4 to +5.

JumpInBuffer.Name: Jump-In Buffer Increase (+6)
JumpInBuffer.Description: The temporary Integrity buffer you gain on a successful Jump-In increases from +5 to +6.

UptimeEconomyMastery.Name: Uptime Economy Mastery
UptimeEconomyMastery.Description: Once per encounter, when your fielded-fleet drip resolves at the start of your turn, you gain [[/gain 2 hr]]{2 Uptime} instead of the usual per-machine total for that tick only. Your Uptime cap still applies.

FleetCap6.Name: Fleet Cap +1 (6)
FleetCap6.Description: Your fleet size cap increases to 6 machines.

Overclock.Name: Overclock
Overclock.Description:
Your epic capstone. Once per encounter, when you Deploy or Command, you can overclock the fleet as a free triggered action. Until the end of your next turn:

  • Uptime costs on your abilities are 2 less (minimum 1).

  • Every machine you control gains a +2 Integrity temporary buffer.

When Overclock ends, you can’t gain Uptime from the fielded-fleet drip until the start of your following turn.

v1 — a cross-class epic pass may revisit this.

DeployAndCommand.Name: Deploy & Command
DeployAndCommand.Story: Bring the hardware online, then tell it what to do.
DeployAndCommand.Effect_before0000000000:
Deploy (main action): bring a carried drone, turret, or vehicle online in an unoccupied space within distance; it’s now under your control. No roll.

Command (maneuver): each machine you control within distance acts on your turn, per its programmed behavior or your direct call. Roll only if enemy electronic warfare contests the command.

Uptime cost 0.
DeployAndCommand.Tier1: Deploy: the machine is sluggish this round (acts last, no maneuver). Command: your machines act, but one machine you choose can only reposition.
DeployAndCommand.Tier2: Deploy: the machine acts normally this round. Command: every commanded machine acts as directed.
DeployAndCommand.Tier3: Deploy: the machine also banks a free maneuver for later this round. Command: every commanded machine acts, and you gain 1 Uptime.

RiggedFire.Name: Rigged Fire
RiggedFire.Effect_before0000000000:
Distance: The firing machine’s weapon range.

A machine you control makes a mounted attack. Roll with Logic, or Reflex if you are Jumped-In to the firing machine, and add Gunnery.

Uptime costs and numbers are v1 estimates pending calibration.
RiggedFire.Tier1: The shot goes wide: no damage, and enemies have an edge on power rolls against the firing machine until your next turn.
RiggedFire.Tier3: 5 + Logic damage, and choose one: the target is knocked prone, the target is suppressed until the end of its next turn, or the firing machine can reposition up to its Speed.

FieldRepair.Name: Field Repair
FieldRepair.Effect_before0000000000:
Full repair (main action) uses the results below. Quick patch (maneuver): restore the low-result Integrity only, with no condition cleared. On an ally’s chrome or jammed weapon, the same roll restores function instead of Integrity.

Uptime costs and numbers are v1 estimates pending calibration.
FieldRepair.Tier1: Restore 2 + Logic Integrity; the repair holds only until the target is next hit.
FieldRepair.Tier2: Restore 4 + Logic Integrity and clear one machine condition (Crippled, Systems Down, On Fire/Leaking).
FieldRepair.Tier3: Restore 6 + Logic Integrity, clear one machine condition, and gain 1 Uptime (a maintenance tick).

OverridePing.Name: Override Ping
OverridePing.Story: The rig’s answer to “what happens when they try to jam you.”
OverridePing.Trigger: A machine you control would be jammed, spoofed, or forced into a fault state by an enemy electronic warfare effect.
OverridePing.Effect_before0000000000: You push a priority override packet through the link: the machine ignores the triggering effect this round. You spend 1 Uptime to do this (a spend, not a drain). You can’t use this ability with 0 Uptime.

FocusFire.Name: Focus Fire
FocusFire.Effect_before0000000000:
Distance: Each firing machine’s weapon range.

Every machine you currently control makes a Rigged Fire attack against one target, or splits its fire between two. Roll once for each participating machine; each roll uses the results below for that machine only.

Uptime costs and numbers are v1 estimates pending calibration.
FocusFire.Tier1: That machine’s shot goes wide: no damage.
FocusFire.Tier3: 5 + Logic damage from that machine, plus the Rigged Fire rider (prone, suppressed, or free reposition).

DroneJockey.Name: Drone Jockey
DroneJockey.Description:
“The swarm.” Street-taught: you learned in a salvage yard and off pirated firmware forums, bricking three cheap quadrotors before the fourth one flew straight. Now you run a swarm — recon quadrotors, kamikaze microdrones, taser-bees, spotter-drones, autoguns — that individually mean nothing and collectively mean the enemy can’t find a square that isn’t watched, tased, or shot. Street name: the swarm, the jockey, or the wall of bees.

Starter Kit: Fabricator’s Bench (Quick Build).

At 1st level you gain the Electronics skill, a drone-parts or grey-market salvage contact, and the Wide Band and Swarm Launch features and the Salvage Sense triggered action. You need no chrome: your power lives in cheap, replaceable hardware.

WideBand.Name: Wide Band
WideBand.Description: Your fleet size cap is 2 higher than the class baseline. A single Command (Deploy & Command as a maneuver) commands your entire swarm at once, however many machines it has.

SwarmLaunch.Name: Swarm Launch
SwarmLaunch.Description:
Your signatures, in your hands:

  • Deploy & Command: a single Deploy can bring up to 2 microdrones online at once, each individually fragile.

  • Rigged Fire: when 3 or more of your drones fire in the same Focus Fire, the target is suppressed regardless of the rolls.

  • Field Repair: on a drone, the repair restores its full Integrity: you either fix it completely or write it off.

SuppressingVolume.Name: Suppressing Volume
SuppressingVolume.Description: A Focus Fire made by 3 or more of your drones suppresses the target regardless of the individual rolls.

CheapAndMany.Name: Cheap and Many
CheapAndMany.Description: Once per encounter, you can redeploy a wrecked Micro drone from spare parts as a maneuver instead of a main action.

SwarmSense.Name: Swarm Sense
SwarmSense.Description: While 3 or more of your drones are active, you have an edge on Instinct tests to notice ambushes or hidden threats.

Overwhelm.Name: Overwhelm
Overwhelm.Description: When 4 or more of your drones target the same creature in one Focus Fire, that creature’s Armor counts as 1 lower for that action.

EndlessSwarm.Name: Endless Swarm
EndlessSwarm.Description: Your fleet size cap increases by a further 2 (4 above the class baseline in total), and your Deploy momentum income is doubled.

WideBandRedoubled.Name: Wide Band, Redoubled
WideBandRedoubled.Description: Wide Band’s whole-swarm Command no longer requires your drones to be within distance: it reaches every drone you control.

TotalCoverage.Name: Total Coverage
TotalCoverage.Description: While 3 or more of your drones are active, each ally also gains Swarm Sense’s edge to notice ambushes and hidden threats.

SalvageSense.Name: Salvage Sense
SalvageSense.Trigger: A drone you control is wrecked.
SalvageSense.Effect_before0000000000: You immediately strip the wreck for parts and [[/gain 1 hr]]{gain 1 Uptime} (a salvage tick).

BeeStorm.Name: Bee Storm
BeeStorm.Effect_before0000000000:
Distance: 3 burst around your swarm.

Every taser-bee you control converges on an area: up to 3 creatures in a 3 burst.

Uptime costs and numbers are v1 estimates pending calibration.
BeeStorm.Tier3: Each target is slowed and bleeding (save ends).

AutogunLockdown.Name: Autogun Lockdown
AutogunLockdown.Effect_before0000000000:
Distance: 3 burst within the autogun’s mount range.

An autogun turret-drone establishes an area of control. Until the start of your next turn, any enemy that enters or acts in the zone triggers a free Rigged Fire from the autogun.

Uptime costs and numbers are v1 estimates pending calibration.

SensorGhost.Name: Sensor Ghost
SensorGhost.Effect_before0000000000:
A recon drone projects a false sensor return: until the start of your next turn, the target has concealment against Wired-assisted targeting (smartlinks, drone gunners, sensor fusion).

Uptime costs and numbers are v1 estimates pending calibration.

SwarmReposition.Name: Swarm Reposition
SwarmReposition.Effect_before0000000000:
Every drone you control can reposition up to its Speed. No attack.

Uptime costs and numbers are v1 estimates pending calibration.

FocusSting.Name: Focus Sting
FocusSting.Effect_before0000000000:
Distance: Any active taser-bee’s range.

Every active taser-bee converges its charge into a single overload strike.

Uptime costs and numbers are v1 estimates pending calibration.

WideEyes.Name: Wide Eyes
WideEyes.Trigger: An ally within 10 squares of one of your active drones is about to be flanked or ambushed.
WideEyes.Effect_before0000000000:
Your recon net calls the warning a half-second early: the ally can reposition 2 squares before the triggering effect resolves.

Uptime costs and numbers are v1 estimates pending calibration.

SaturationFire.Name: Saturation Fire
SaturationFire.Effect_before0000000000:
Distance: 4 burst within your drones’ weapon range.

Every autogun and armed drone opens up at once on up to 4 creatures in a 4 burst. Roll once for all targets.

Uptime costs and numbers are v1 estimates pending calibration.
SaturationFire.Tier3: Each target is suppressed until the end of its next turn.

GhostSwarm.Name: Ghost Swarm
GhostSwarm.Effect_before0000000000:
For one round, every drone you control is hidden, even if observed, as long as it doesn’t attack.

Uptime costs and numbers are v1 estimates pending calibration.

KamikazeVolley.Name: Kamikaze Volley
KamikazeVolley.Effect_before0000000000:
Distance: Your microdrones’ flight.

Up to three microdrones detonate against up to three separate targets. The expended drones are destroyed.

Uptime costs and numbers are v1 estimates pending calibration.

AdaptiveNet.Name: Adaptive Net
AdaptiveNet.Trigger: A drone you control would be destroyed.
AdaptiveNet.Effect_before0000000000:
The drone survives at 1 Integrity, and you can immediately reposition it up to its Speed away from danger.

Uptime costs and numbers are v1 estimates pending calibration.

TotalSwarmProtocol.Name: Total Swarm Protocol
TotalSwarmProtocol.Effect_before0000000000:
Distance: 5 squares of any active drone.

Once per encounter. Every drone you control, however many, makes a Rigged Fire attack, splitting freely among all valid targets in range. Roll once per participating drone. This is Focus Fire with no target cap.

Uptime costs and numbers are v1 estimates pending calibration.

UnbreakableHive.Name: Unbreakable Hive
UnbreakableHive.Description:
Whenever a drone you control would be destroyed, make a saving throw for it (Draw Steel saving throws succeed on 6 or higher). On a success, it instead drops to 1 Integrity and is Systems Down (inactive, not destroyed) until you spend a maneuver to reboot it. Once per drone per encounter.

Uptime costs and numbers are v1 estimates pending calibration.

TaserSwarm.Name: Taser Swarm
TaserSwarm.Effect_before0000000000:
Distance: Any active drone’s weapon range.

A taser-bee drone (or three) closes and delivers a shock payload.

Uptime costs and numbers are v1 estimates pending calibration.
TaserSwarm.Tier2: 2 + Logic damage; the target is slowed (save ends).
TaserSwarm.Tier3: 3 + Logic damage; the target is stunned until the end of its next turn.

KamikazeRun.Name: Kamikaze Run
KamikazeRun.Effect_before0000000000:
Distance: A microdrone’s flight.

One microdrone flies into the target and detonates. The drone is always destroyed.

Uptime costs and numbers are v1 estimates pending calibration.

SpotterLock.Name: Spotter Lock
SpotterLock.Effect_before0000000000:
A spotter-drone marks the target: the next Rigged Fire or Focus Fire against it this round gains an edge. No damage.

Uptime costs and numbers are v1 estimates pending calibration.

ReconLoop.Name: Recon Loop
ReconLoop.Effect_before0000000000:
A recon quadrotor sweeps a 10-square radius: until the start of your next turn, you know the position of every creature in the area, even through light cover.

Uptime costs and numbers are v1 estimates pending calibration.

BuzzsawPass.Name: Buzzsaw Pass
BuzzsawPass.Effect_before0000000000:
Distance: Melee 1 from an adjacent drone.

A close-quarters microdrone with a monofilament edge makes a strafing pass.

Uptime costs and numbers are v1 estimates pending calibration.
BuzzsawPass.Tier2: The drone can reposition up to its Speed afterward.

DecoyChirp.Name: Decoy Chirp
DecoyChirp.Trigger: An enemy targets you or an ally with a ranged attack.
DecoyChirp.Effect_before0000000000:
A drone broadcasts a false heat and comm signature: the attack must target the drone instead, if the drone is a valid target in range.

Uptime costs and numbers are v1 estimates pending calibration.

VehicleRigPilot.Name: Vehicle Rig-Pilot
VehicleRigPilot.Description:
“The driver.” Street-taught: maybe it’s the truck you hauled freight in for six years before the corp cut your route, a spider-tank frame you rebuilt system by system out of a scrapyard, or a platform stolen outright with its VIN burned off. When you Jump in, the line between driver and machine gets thin enough that nobody can say which one they’re shooting at. Street name: the driver, the rig, or whatever you named the machine.

Starter Kit: Rigger’s Harness (Quick Build).

At 1st level you gain the Piloting skill, a chop-shop or transport contact, and the One With the Machine, Pilot and Gunner, and Wake the Platform features. Your defining chrome is the control rig, a deep-Jump interface implant.

OneWithTheMachine.Name: One With the Machine
OneWithTheMachine.Description: Jumping in to your registered signature platform costs 1 fewer Uptime, and your Jump-In Integrity buffer on it is 2 higher than the class baseline.

PilotAndGunner.Name: Pilot and Gunner
PilotAndGunner.Description: While Jumped-In, you occupy both the Pilot and a Gunner station at once, and you gain an edge on Rigged Fire made this way.

WakeThePlatform.Name: Wake the Platform
WakeThePlatform.Description:
Your signatures, in your hands:

  • Deploy & Command: deploying your signature platform “wakes it up” — it arrives ready for you to Jump in, with no separate maneuver needed to jack in.

  • Rigged Fire: from a Jumped-In vehicle, it can strike two targets in a line along a mount’s firing arc.

  • Field Repair: on your own platform, it restores more Integrity than the class baseline.

LineBreaker.Name: Line Breaker
LineBreaker.Description: Rigged Fire from a Jumped-In vehicle can target 2 creatures in a line within the weapon’s arc, with one roll.

HardenedRig.Name: Hardened Rig
HardenedRig.Description:
While Jumped-In, biofeedback damage to your body is reduced by 2.

Uptime costs and numbers are v1 estimates pending calibration.

RedlineReflexes.Name: Redline Reflexes
RedlineReflexes.Description: While Jumped-In, your platform’s full Speed counts as your own Speed for any ability that cares about your Speed.

ScrapheapLoyalty.Name: Scrapheap Loyalty
ScrapheapLoyalty.Description: Once per respite, you can field-repair your signature platform to full Integrity outside of downtime, as long as you have access to a workshop (a Physical Upgrade Slot).

GhostInTheFrame.Name: Ghost in the Frame
GhostInTheFrame.Description: While Jumped-In, if your platform would be wrecked, you can spend all your remaining Uptime to eject safely, taking no biofeedback damage.

RedlineMastery.Name: Redline Mastery
RedlineMastery.Description: While Jumped-In, Redline Reflexes also gives your platform +1 Handling.

OneFramePerfectTiming.Name: One Frame, Perfect Timing

FacilityRigger.Name: Facility Rigger
FacilityRigger.Description:
“The warlord.” Street-taught: what started as a squat in a collapsed sub-level became a fortress one wired sentry at a time — a turret in the stairwell nobody uses, a mesh-web across the service corridor, a breaching charge under the floor where a strike team would stack up. When the fight comes to you, nothing needs deploying; it’s been deployed for months. Street name: the warlord, the landlord, or the ghost in the walls.

Starter Kit: Field Chassis (Quick Build).

At 1st level you gain the Security Systems skill, a parts-supplier or quartermaster contact, and the Home Ground, Pre-Wired, and Built to Be Serviced features. Your power lives in the building (see the Building stat card in THE MACHINES), not the body.

HomeGround.Name: Home Ground
HomeGround.Description: While you fight inside or adjacent to your registered base of operations, Deploy actions for pre-placed assets cost 1 fewer Uptime.

PreWired.Name: Pre-Wired
PreWired.Description: During downtime, you can designate up to 2 Physical Upgrade Slot assets as primed. The first time combat starts at that site, primed assets activate as a free triggered action.

BuiltToBeServiced.Name: Built to Be Serviced
BuiltToBeServiced.Description:
Your signatures, in your hands:

  • Deploy & Command: instead of deploying a carried machine, you activate a pre-placed asset already wired into your base, at reduced Uptime cost.

  • Rigged Fire: fire from a pre-placed turret counts as having prepared cover unless the enemy specifically flanks it.

  • Field Repair: repairing a Physical Upgrade Slot asset (a turret, a mesh-web generator) is faster and cheaper than repairing a mobile drone.

KillboxInstinct.Name: Killbox Instinct

MeshWebDoctrine.Name: Mesh-Web Doctrine

FortifiedNode.Name: Fortified Node

TheBuildingRemembers.Name: The Building Remembers
TheBuildingRemembers.Description: Your base never loses Downtime Fabrication progress, even if it’s abandoned and later reclaimed. Additionally, its Physical Upgrade Slot assets repair 1 Integrity per downtime cycle on their own.

FortressDoctrine.Name: Fortress Doctrine

TheWarlordsReach.Name: The Warlord’s Reach

Class.Name: Elementalist
Class.Description:
You are an Elementalist — a hexer, a stormhead, or on a clean corp badge an arcano-thaumic contractor. You are the crew’s spellcaster and its artillery: you win by rewriting the battlefield, hurling fire and lightning across a room, freezing a chokepoint solid, raising a wall of stone, and at full power tearing an elemental loose from across the Veil to fight at your side.

You are always attuned to one element — fire, air, water, earth, or void — and your attunement drips Essence every turn. Commit a maneuver to Channel and you bank a growing ramp on top of the drip, released in a crescendo. Because you reach across the Veil, the Veil’s rules apply to you: backlash, spirit attention, and the Price (nothing for nothing).

⚠ Cyborgs can never be Elementalists. Arcane Severance bars a Cyborg from all magic, absolutely. This is enforced at character creation: if you built a Cyborg, choose a different class or People before play.

Chrome is strongly discouraged. Cyberware erodes a mage’s channeling: Salvage and Standard implants each cut your Essence cap (Salvage also slows your Channel ramp); only soft bioware is tolerable, at 1 lost cap per two implants. Your gear is foci, not chrome.

Your subclass is your element cluster: Pyromancer (fire), Stormcaller (air and water), or Geomancer (earth and void).

Core characteristics: Logic, Persona · Heroic resource: Essence · Starting Stamina: 18 (+6 per level) · Recoveries: 8 · Kit: optional (Hexshot, Spellblade, or Sanctified). Quick Build: Pyromancer, no Kit.

Essence.Name: Essence
Essence.Description:
Essence is the shaped substance of creation, banked by attunement and spent on workings.

Attunement

You are always attuned to one element: fire, air, water, earth, or void. Choosing or switching your attunement is free (no action) on your turn. Your attunement sets which element your drip and your Channel produce.

Essence in Combat

  • Start of combat: gain Essence equal to [[lookup @hero.victories]]{your Victories}.

  • The drip: at the start of each of your turns, gain [[/gain 1 hr]]{1 Essence} (Foundry adds this automatically).

  • Channel (maneuver): bank extra Essence of your attuned element. Channeling the same element on consecutive turns ramps: [[/gain 2 hr]]{+2} on the first turn, [[/gain 3 hr]]{+3} on the second, [[/gain 4 hr]]{+4} on the third and later. Switching your attunement resets the ramp to +2.

  • Elemental Resonance: the first time each combat round typed elemental damage from your own workings lands, [[/gain 1 hr]]{gain 1 Essence}.

A committed caster at full ramp banks +5 per turn, or +6 when resonance lands. One who skips Channel banks only the +1 drip.

Cap and Loss

Your Essence cap is 8 at Echelon 1, 12 at Echelon 2, 16 at Echelon 3, and 20 at Echelon 4 (up to 24 at 10th level). You lose all unspent Essence at the end of the encounter.

Sustaining Workings

Sustaining a persistent working (a wall, a zone, a bound elemental) reduces the Essence you bank at the start of each turn: −2 Essence per turn for each point of the working’s Persistent rating (Persistent 1 = −2, Persistent 2 = −4, Persistent 4 = −8, Persistent 6 = −12). A heavy hit can break your concentration and end sustained workings (a Persona save against the attack’s potency).

Essence Outside of Combat

You can’t gain Essence outside of combat, but you can use Essence abilities without spending it. Whenever you do, you can’t use that same ability outside combat again until you earn 1 or more Victories or finish a respite. You can sustain a persistent working outside combat for a number of rounds equal to your Victories.

Firewall: Essence never touches nuyen or Body Integrity, and chrome never generates it.

In Foundry, the drip is automatic; Channel, Resonance, sustain drains, and the cap are tracked with the buttons above.

WeaveSensitivity.Name: Weave Sensitivity
WeaveSensitivity.Description: You passively detect Veil-adjacent phenomena within 5 squares: spirits, sustained workings, magical effects, and corrupted zones. You know when the Veil is thin near you.

AttunementDiscipline.Name: Attunement Discipline
AttunementDiscipline.Description: You can switch your attuned element as a free action even during another creature’s turn. Whenever you switch elements, you [[/gain 1 hr]]{gain 1 Essence}.

PracticedRamp.Name: Practiced Ramp
PracticedRamp.Description: While attuned to your subclass’s primary element (fire for Pyromancer, air or water for Stormcaller, earth or void for Geomancer), your Channel ramp starts at +3 instead of +2.

ElementalAttunementII.Name: Elemental Attunement II
ElementalAttunementII.Description: You have immunity to your subclass’s primary element damage equal to [[lookup @R]]{your Logic score}. This stacks with subclass immunities.

SignatureBond.Name: Signature Bond
SignatureBond.Description: Once per echelon, you can permanently bond one signature focus (from the Elementalist foci in Ghostwire Foci). A bonded focus gains the deeper persistent benefit its own text describes. Bonding costs 1 skill point — the one sanctioned crossing of the BP firewall. You can have only one bonded focus at a time; unbonding requires a respite.

BindDiscipline.Name: Bind Discipline
BindDiscipline.Description: You gain +1 on all Persona-based bind rolls (Summon Elemental, Veilbreaker Bind, and subclass equivalents).

ElementalAttunementIII.Name: Elemental Attunement III
ElementalAttunementIII.Description: Your immunity to your subclass’s primary element damage becomes twice your Logic score. You also gain a permanent secondary attunement type: a Pyromancer picks lightning or acid, a Stormcaller cold or sonic, a Geomancer void or corruption.

WeaveMastery.Name: Weave Mastery — The Deep Weave
WeaveMastery.Description: As a respite activity, you can establish a standing bind on a signature elemental of any Rank up to your echelon − 1. It persists on the material plane for the current story arc (Director’s discretion), acts independently on the shared round, and costs you 1 Essence per turn to sustain, but only while you are awake and conscious.

ElementalAttunementIV.Name: Elemental Attunement IV
ElementalAttunementIV.Description: Your immunity to your subclass’s primary element damage becomes three times your Logic score. You can permanently attune to two elements at once (as Attunement Ascendant), replacing the secondary attunement from Elemental Attunement III.

AscendantWeave.Name: Ascendant Weave
AscendantWeave.Description: Your bind rolls to summon and command gain a permanent edge. Your standing bind from Weave Mastery can hold a Rank up to your echelon. Once per encounter, you can sustain one persistent working with no Essence cost, in addition to those you sustain normally.

PrimordialReservoir.Name: Primordial Reservoir
PrimordialReservoir.Description:
You have an epic resource called Reservoir. Each time you finish a respite, you gain Reservoir equal to the XP you gain. You can spend Reservoir on your abilities as if it were Essence.

As a free maneuver, you can spend any amount of Reservoir to end one save-ends effect on yourself per Reservoir spent. You can spend 3 Reservoir to sustain any persistent working for one turn at no Essence cost.

Reservoir remains until you spend it.

HurlElement.Name: Hurl Element
HurlElement.Story: The everyday blaster tool, typed to whatever you’re attuned to.
HurlElement.Effect_before0000000000: The damage type matches your attunement (acid, cold, corruption, fire, lightning, poison, or sonic).
HurlElement.Effect_spend00000000000: For each Essence spent: deal 1 extra damage, push the target 1 square, or (spending 2 or more) splash a second target within 2 squares for half damage.

ElementalShaping.Name: Elemental Shaping
ElementalShaping.Story: A gust, a stone bridge, a wave, a blink of storm.
ElementalShaping.Effect_before0000000000: Choose one when you use this ability: a burst of elemental damage to a creature, a forced slide of a creature, or a shift for yourself.
ElementalShaping.Effect_spend00000000000: For each Essence spent, the chosen effect increases by 1 (damage, slide, or shift).
ElementalShaping.Tier1: 2 elemental damage, or slide 1, or shift 1.
ElementalShaping.Tier2: 4 elemental damage, or slide 2, or shift 2.
ElementalShaping.Tier3: 6 elemental damage, or slide 3, or shift 3.

ReadTheWeave.Name: Read the Weave
ReadTheWeave.Story: Free intel that sets up binds and banishments.
ReadTheWeave.Effect_before0000000000: Sense the Veil around you or read one entity or working you can perceive.
ReadTheWeave.Tier1: You sense how thin the Veil is here, or know that magic is present.
ReadTheWeave.Tier2: You read an entity’s rank or nature, or identify a working and what it does.
ReadTheWeave.Tier3: As a middle result, and you learn a bound creature’s true name: your later Persona-based binds against it gain an edge.

ElementalConvergence.Name: Elemental Convergence
ElementalConvergence.Story: A bigger Tempest, with a rider for every element.
ElementalConvergence.Effect_before0000000000:
Add a rider by your attunement: fire — each target burns for 2 damage (save ends); cold — slowed (save ends); lightning — dazed (save ends); acid or corruption — weakened (save ends); void — pull each target 3 squares toward the center of the area.

First-draft working (playtest tuning pending).
ElementalConvergence.Effect_persistent000000: Re-detonate the area each turn (−4 Essence banked per turn).

VeilbreakerBind.Name: Veilbreaker Bind
VeilbreakerBind.Story: The counter-caster tool: steal a rival’s elemental.
VeilbreakerBind.Effect_before0000000000:
Force a hostile summoned or native elemental into a contested Persona bind. On a success, you control it for the encounter as an allied elemental of its own Rank. On a failure, you take [[/damage 2d6]]{2d6} backlash damage and the elemental gains an edge on its next attack.

First-draft working (playtest tuning pending).

SecondRamp.Name: Second Ramp
SecondRamp.Story: The tempo swing: refill and max the ramp.
SecondRamp.Effect_before0000000000:
You immediately [[/gain 3 hr]]{gain 3 Essence}, and your next Channel this encounter grants +4 regardless of your ramp.

First-draft working (playtest tuning pending).

SanctumStone.Name: Sanctum Stone
SanctumStone.Story: A warded circle of consecrated element.
SanctumStone.Effect_before0000000000:
Distance: Aura 3 centered on a point within 5 squares.

Enemies in the aura take a bane on attacks, allies in the aura gain an edge on Persona saves, and forced movement into the aura is halved.

First-draft working (playtest tuning pending).
SanctumStone.Effect_persistent000000: Sustain the circle (−4 Essence banked per turn).

Cataclysm.Name: Cataclysm
Cataclysm.Story: The firestorm that strips the Director’s Malice.
Cataclysm.Effect_before0000000000:
Damage typed to your attunement.

First-draft working (playtest tuning pending).
Cataclysm.Tier1: Only the primary target is caught, and Alert/spirit attention ticks up by 1.
Cataclysm.Tier2: The ground in the area stays difficult terrain until the end of the encounter.

VoidVortex.Name: Void Vortex
VoidVortex.Story: The vortex that destroys the winded.
VoidVortex.Effect_before0000000000:
Void or corruption damage to each enemy in the aura each round. At the start of each enemy’s turn while sustained, pull it 2 squares toward you; an enemy at 0 Stamina or winded when its turn starts inside the vortex is destroyed (Rank 1 elementals, minions, and lower absolutely; Rank 2 and higher take maximum damage instead).

First-draft working (playtest tuning pending).
VoidVortex.Effect_persistent000000: Sustain the vortex (−8 Essence banked per turn).

WorldFissure.Name: World-Fissure
WorldFissure.Effect_before0000000000:
The ground along the line becomes an impassable fissure for the rest of the encounter, with difficult terrain 3 squares to either side. Geomancers can also take this as their 9th-level specialization ability.

First-draft working (playtest tuning pending).

TwinElementalSummon.Name: Twin Elemental Summon
TwinElementalSummon.Story: Double your action economy, at a huge Essence bite.
TwinElementalSummon.Effect_before0000000000:
Bind two elementals with one action and one bind roll (as Summon Elemental). Both can be extensions, or (echelon 3 or higher) one can be an independent figure. Sustain Persistent 3 (−6 per turn) for two extensions, or Persistent 5 (−10 per turn) for an independent plus an extension. A broken bind on either turns both hostile.

First-draft working (playtest tuning pending).
TwinElementalSummon.Effect_persistent000000: Sustain the pair: Persistent 3 for two extensions (−6 Essence banked per turn), Persistent 5 with an independent figure (−10 per turn).
TwinElementalSummon.Tier1: The bind fails: both elementals are hostile and free for one round.
TwinElementalSummon.Tier2: Both are bound, but each resists one Command per encounter.
TwinElementalSummon.Tier3: Both are bound cleanly, with an edge on Command rolls.

GreaterElementalSummon.Name: Greater Elemental Summon
GreaterElementalSummon.Effect_before0000000000:
Bind a Rank 4 elemental (Rank 5 at echelon 4) as an independent figure with its own Stamina, maneuvers, and signature (an Ancient Flame, a Roaring Storm, a Living Mountain, a Devouring Void). A willing elemental demands a greater task; coercing one costs 3 corruption and 3 spirit attention.

First-draft working (playtest tuning pending).
GreaterElementalSummon.Effect_persistent000000: Sustain the greater elemental (−12 Essence banked per turn).

WorldSundering.Name: World-Sundering
WorldSundering.Story: An elemental scar that lasts the session.
WorldSundering.Effect_before0000000000:
No roll. Each enemy in the area whose potency is strong or weaker takes [[/damage 20+@R]]{20 + Logic} elemental damage and is knocked prone; an enemy of weak potency is instead reduced to 0 Stamina; minions are destroyed. The area becomes an elemental scar for the rest of the session: difficult terrain that deals 3 damage per turn to any non-elemental creature crossing it.

First-draft working (playtest tuning pending).

AttunementAscendant.Name: Attunement Ascendant
AttunementAscendant.Story: A walking hurricane of typed damage.
AttunementAscendant.Effect_before0000000000:
Until the end of the encounter, your Channel ramp is already at +4 and doesn’t reset when you switch attunement, and you can attune to two elements at once, gaining both drips and resonance. Your signature abilities can combine damage types (fire and lightning make plasma; earth and water make mud; the Director rules on the effect).

First-draft working (playtest tuning pending).

BreakTheVeil.Name: Break the Veil
BreakTheVeil.Effect_before0000000000:
The Veil thins around you. Until the end of the encounter, each ally in the aura sustains persistent workings at reduced cost (Persistent 2 becomes 1, draining −2 per turn; Persistent 4 becomes 2, draining −4 per turn), you sustain one persistent working at no Essence cost, and your signature and heroic ability rolls gain an edge.

First-draft working (playtest tuning pending).
BreakTheVeil.Effect_persistent000000: Break the Veil itself is Persistent 4 on cast (−8 Essence banked per turn).

BoltBarrage.Name: Bolt Barrage
BoltBarrage.Story: Two targets banged for real, or one hit twice as hard.
BoltBarrage.Effect_before0000000000: Target up to 2 creatures. If you target only 1 creature, add your Logic score to the damage again.

DifficultGround.Name: Difficult Ground
DifficultGround.Story: A live zone that punishes every step across it.
DifficultGround.Effect_before0000000000: The ground in the area becomes difficult terrain until the start of your next turn.
DifficultGround.Effect_persistent000000: Sustain the zone (−2 Essence banked per turn).

ElementalWall.Name: Elemental Wall
ElementalWall.Story: Block a line, force a chokepoint, punish the room.
ElementalWall.Effect_before0000000000: A wall of flame, stone, ice, or force blocks line of effect and movement as its element allows. The damage applies to each enemy that enters the wall’s space or starts its turn adjacent to it.
ElementalWall.Effect_persistent000000: Sustain and extend the wall (−2 Essence banked per turn).

ConflagrationTempest.Name: Conflagration / Tempest
ConflagrationTempest.Story: Firestorm, ball lightning, acid rain, choking dust, roiling void.
ConflagrationTempest.Effect_before0000000000: Heavy elemental damage to each enemy in the area, flavored by your attuned element.
ConflagrationTempest.Effect_persistent000000: Re-detonate the area each turn without paying the cost again (−4 Essence banked per turn).

SummonElemental.Name: Summon Elemental
SummonElemental.Story: The class’s defining working: the real cost is the upkeep.
SummonElemental.Effect_before0000000000:
You tear an elemental loose from the Veil and bind it. Make the bind roll: a power roll with Logic, with an edge if your Persona is equal to or higher than your Logic (Bind Discipline adds +1).

  • Extension (1st–5th level): a Rank 1 elemental that acts on your turn, dealing 4/7/10 + Logic damage by result. Sustain: Persistent 2 (−4 Essence banked per turn).

  • Independent figure (7th level and later, or a properly bound mid-level caster): its own figure on the map with its own Stamina and turn (Rank 2 from 5th level). Sustain: Persistent 4 (−8 Essence banked per turn).

The Price: a willing elemental demands a task aligned to its nature; coercing an unwilling one costs 1 corruption and 1 spirit-attention tick per Rank. A heavy hit while you sustain it can break the bind (Persona save against the potency).
SummonElemental.Effect_persistent000000: Sustain the bound elemental: extension Persistent 2 (−4 Essence banked per turn); independent figure Persistent 4 (−8 Essence banked per turn).
SummonElemental.Tier1: The bind fails: the elemental is hostile and free for one round, then the Veil pulls it back.
SummonElemental.Tier2: The elemental is bound, but resists one Command per encounter.
SummonElemental.Tier3: The elemental is bound cleanly, and you gain an edge on Command rolls for it.

Pyromancer.Name: Pyromancer
Pyromancer.Description:
“Combustion-thaumic specialist.” Fire, plasma, and destruction: the archetypal blaster. Street: firehead, candle, or the pyro.

At 1st level you gain the Spellcraft skill (the chapter’s Arcana), the Burn On feature, the Ember Companion signature summon, and a signature focus: the Spark-ring (Ghostwire Foci). A Pyromancer takes no weapon Kit by default.

BurnOn.Name: Burn On
BurnOn.Description: Whenever you deal fire, lightning, or acid damage to a creature with a signature or heroic ability, that creature also takes fire damage at the start of its next turn: 4 at echelon 1, 3 at echelon 2, 2 at echelon 3, and 1 at echelon 4.

FirestormAttunement.Name: Firestorm Attunement
FirestormAttunement.Description: While attuned to fire, lightning, or acid, your Channel ramp builds a step faster: +3 on the first turn and +4 on the second.

FireImmunity.Name: Fire Immunity
FireImmunity.Description: You have fire immunity equal to [[lookup @R]]{your Logic score}. You can walk through fire, sustain a fire wall from inside it, and take no ambient fire damage from a Cataclysm you sustain.

FuryRising.Name: Fury Rising
FuryRising.Description: Whenever you spend 5 or more Essence in a single turn, you [[/surge 1]] (usable until the end of your next turn), and your next signature ability this encounter deals extra damage equal to your Logic score.

TheFurnaceWithin.Name: The Furnace Within
TheFurnaceWithin.Description: You gain +1 on Logic-based power rolls. Once per round, a fire, lightning, or acid working costs you 1 less Essence (minimum 0).

EmberCompanion.Name: Ember Companion
EmberCompanion.Story: A lash of living flame, bound for a moment.
EmberCompanion.Effect_before0000000000:
Once per encounter, you summon a Rank 1 elemental as an extension: it appears within distance, acts on your turn, and lasts 3 rounds with no sustain cost. When you use this ability, the elemental makes the strike below.

It doesn’t replace Summon Elemental; it’s a taste of the summoner fantasy from 1st level.

Wildfire.Name: Wildfire
Wildfire.Tier2: The area becomes a burning zone until the end of the encounter: difficult terrain that deals 3 fire damage per turn to enemies inside.
Wildfire.Tier3: The area becomes a burning zone until the end of the encounter: difficult terrain that deals 3 fire damage per turn to enemies inside.

CleansingFlame.Name: Cleansing Flame
CleansingFlame.Effect_before0000000000: End all save-ends fire, acid, poison, and corruption effects on the target. The target gains [[/heal 2*@R temporary]]{temporary Stamina equal to twice your Logic score}.

SolarLance.Name: Solar Lance
SolarLance.Story: A line of sunfire that ignores cover.

CombustionChain.Name: Combustion Chain
CombustionChain.Story: One burning target lights the next.
CombustionChain.Effect_before0000000000: If the target is at half Stamina or below, the fire chains to a second creature within 3 squares for 5/8/11 + Logic fire damage by result. If the second target dies from this, it chains to a third within 3 squares for 3/5/8 + Logic.

LivingSun.Name: Living Sun
LivingSun.Effect_before0000000000: Bright light fills the aura. While it lasts, each enemy in the aura takes the damage at the start of each of its turns, and each ally in the aura can spend a Recovery as a free maneuver once per turn.
LivingSun.Effect_persistent000000: Sustain the sun (−8 Essence banked per turn).

AshenWake.Name: Ashen Wake
AshenWake.Effect_before0000000000: The area becomes ashen ground until the end of the session: difficult terrain that blocks line of sight through it and deals 3 fire damage per turn to any creature without fire immunity.

Stormcaller.Name: Stormcaller
Stormcaller.Description:
“Kinetic-atmospheric specialist.” Air, water, and mobility: the battlefield mover. Street: stormhead, windbag (derogatory), or the tempest.

At 1st level you gain the Perception skill, the Kinetic Enlargement feature, the Zephyr Companion signature summon, and a signature focus: the Storm-tine or the Riverstone (Ghostwire Foci). A Stormcaller takes no weapon Kit by default.

KineticEnlargement.Name: Kinetic Enlargement
KineticEnlargement.Description: Whenever a signature or heroic ability you use includes forced movement or a shift or teleport for yourself, that movement increases by 3 squares at echelons 1–2, 2 squares at echelon 3, and 1 square at echelon 4.

RidingTheStorm.Name: Riding the Storm
RidingTheStorm.Description: While attuned to air or water, your speed increases by 2. Once per encounter, when you use Elemental Shaping’s shift option, you can teleport instead, ignoring intervening terrain and creatures.

StormsBlessing.Name: Storm’s Blessing
StormsBlessing.Description: You have lightning immunity equal to [[lookup @R]]{your Logic score}. You and each ally within 3 squares of you gain an edge on Reflex saves against elemental effects.

RollingThunder.Name: Rolling Thunder
RollingThunder.Description: Whenever you deal lightning or cold damage to a creature with a signature or heroic ability, the damage arcs to a second creature within 3 squares for 3 damage of the same type at echelon 1, 2 at echelon 2, and 1 at echelons 3–4.

EyeOfTheStorm.Name: Eye of the Storm
EyeOfTheStorm.Description: You gain +1 on Logic-based power rolls. Once per round, when a creature within 5 squares of you makes an attack against you or an ally, you can force it to reroll; the second roll stands.

ZephyrCompanion.Name: Zephyr Companion
ZephyrCompanion.Story: A striking wind, bound for a moment.
ZephyrCompanion.Effect_before0000000000:
Once per encounter, you summon a Rank 1 elemental as an extension: it appears within distance, acts on your turn, and lasts 3 rounds with no sustain cost. When you use this ability, the elemental makes the strike below. Choose cold, lightning, or sonic damage when you summon it. On a middle or high result, the strike slides the target 1 square.

It doesn’t replace Summon Elemental; it’s a taste of the summoner fantasy from 1st level.

ChainLightning.Name: Chain Lightning
ChainLightning.Effect_before0000000000: The lightning arcs to a second creature within 3 squares of the target for half the damage, then to a third creature within 3 squares of the second for a quarter.

RiptideGrab.Name: Riptide Grab
RiptideGrab.Story: Everyone gets dragged to the middle.
RiptideGrab.Effect_before0000000000: Pull each enemy in the area 3 squares toward the center of the area (5 squares at echelon 2, 7 at echelon 1).
RiptideGrab.Tier1: An enemy pulled into a solid obstacle takes 2 damage.
RiptideGrab.Tier2: An enemy pulled into a solid obstacle takes 4 damage.
RiptideGrab.Tier3: An enemy pulled into a solid obstacle takes 6 damage.

CycloneTrap.Name: Cyclone Trap
CycloneTrap.Effect_persistent000000: Sustain the cyclone (−4 Essence banked per turn).

Skyfall.Name: Skyfall
Skyfall.Effect_before0000000000: Each target with average potency or lower is knocked prone; each target with strong potency or weaker is dazed (save ends).

CataclysmsVoice.Name: Cataclysm’s Voice
CataclysmsVoice.Tier2: Each target is deafened (save ends); a deafened target can’t be commanded by its allies.
CataclysmsVoice.Tier3: Each target is deafened (save ends); a deafened target can’t be commanded by its allies.

TheDeluge.Name: The Deluge
TheDeluge.Effect_before0000000000: Cold or sonic damage. The area fills with water: difficult terrain at half speed, with a chance to drown under the environment rules, and creatures inside take 2 lightning damage per turn from a stormfront overhead.
TheDeluge.Effect_persistent000000: Sustain the flood (−8 Essence banked per turn).

Geomancer.Name: Geomancer
Geomancer.Description:
“Geo-structural / spatial specialist.” Earth, void, and terrain: the fortress. Street: stone-eater, the walls, or grim (for the void-heavy).

At 1st level you gain the Athletics skill (the chapter’s Endurance), the Stone Shield feature, the Boulder Companion signature summon, and a signature focus: the Grave-anchor (Ghostwire Foci). A Geomancer takes no weapon Kit by default.

StoneShield.Name: Stone Shield
StoneShield.Description: Whenever you raise a terrain feature (Elemental Wall, Pillar of Stone, Sanctum Stone, or a Difficult Ground zone), you or one ally within 3 squares gains temporary Stamina equal to your Logic score, doubled at echelon 2 and tripled at echelon 1.

WardingTerrain.Name: Warding Terrain
WardingTerrain.Description: Enemies moving through your Difficult Ground zones or terrain features take 2 extra damage per square, typed to your attunement.

RootDeep.Name: Root Deep
RootDeep.Description: You can’t be force-moved against your will while adjacent to a terrain feature you raised. Your stability increases by 2.

FortressStance.Name: Fortress Stance
FortressStance.Description: Once per encounter as a free maneuver, you raise the square you occupy into a stone pillar. Each adjacent creature makes a Physique test or falls prone, and you have cover and +2 Stamina from armor until you leave the square.

Immutable.Name: Immutable
Immutable.Description: You gain +1 on Logic-based power rolls. You can’t be knocked prone, restrained, or force-moved by any source below Rank 4, though you can choose to fall prone.

BoulderCompanion.Name: Boulder Companion
BoulderCompanion.Story: A stone fist, bound for a moment.
BoulderCompanion.Effect_before0000000000:
Once per encounter, you summon a Rank 1 elemental as an extension: it appears within distance, acts on your turn, and lasts 3 rounds with no sustain cost. When you use this ability, the elemental makes the strike below. Choose acid or corruption damage when you summon it. On a middle or high result, the strike can also shove the target 1 square.

It doesn’t replace Summon Elemental; it’s a taste of the summoner fantasy from 1st level.

PillarOfStone.Name: Pillar of Stone
PillarOfStone.Effect_before0000000000: Raise a stone pillar up to 4 squares tall in a square within distance; a creature in that square is shoved to an adjacent empty square. The pillar blocks line of sight, provides cover, and is impassable. It lasts until the end of the session or until destroyed (Stamina 5 + your echelon).
PillarOfStone.Effect_persistent000000: Sustain and maintain multiple pillars (−2 Essence banked per turn).

Voidstep.Name: Voidstep
Voidstep.Story: Step through a tear in the Veil.
Voidstep.Effect_before0000000000: Teleport up to 10 squares to a location you can see, bringing one adjacent ally with you. The closing tear deals the damage to each enemy adjacent to your destination.

AnchoringField.Name: Anchoring Field
AnchoringField.Effect_before0000000000: Enemies in the aura can’t teleport or be teleported, and their speed is reduced by 2 (save ends).
AnchoringField.Effect_persistent000000: Sustain the field (−6 Essence banked per turn).

VoidGrasp.Name: Void-Grasp
VoidGrasp.Tier2: The target is knocked prone and can’t move (save ends).
VoidGrasp.Tier3: The target is removed from play until the end of your next turn; it returns in the same square and takes [[/damage 2d6]]{2d6} damage.

Class.Name: Street Priest
Class.Description:
You are a Street Priest — padre, collar, saint, or simply the priest. Corp paperwork lists you as a “pastoral-services contractor.” What you actually are is a vessel for a power on the other side of the Veil: an angel or a demon aligned to a cause has agreed to lend you its power, and you channel that aid through sheer conviction. Your patron always wants something back — the Price — and what it wants tells everyone who you are.

You are the crew’s divine switch-hitter: you keep the crew alive (Recovery-fueled healing, wards, status removal) and punish the enemy (holy or corruption smiting, forced movement, fear, banishment). At 1st level you choose a pact alignment, Light or Dark — a permanent overlay on top of your ministry — and a ministry: Shepherd, Templar, or Exorcist.

⚠ Cyborgs can never be Street Priests. Arcane Severance bars a Cyborg from every Veil-casting class; a Full-Conversion chassis can’t hold a pact. The hero sheet refuses the combination.

Chrome ceiling: you can tolerate at most a sliver of soft bioware — a single low-grade implant. Every point of chrome load beyond that permanently lowers your maximum Conviction by 1.

Core characteristics: Persona, Instinct · Heroic resource: Conviction · Starting Stamina: 18 (+6 per level) · Recoveries: 8 · Kit: light (Sanctified, or No Kit). Quick Build: Light pact, Shepherd, Sanctified.

Conviction.Name: Conviction
Conviction.Description:
Conviction is your faith made manifest: your standing with your patron, spent to call aid across the Veil.

Earning Conviction

  • Opening faith: at the start of combat, gain Conviction equal to [[lookup @hero.victories]]{your Victories}.

  • The drip: at the start of each of your turns, gain [[/gain 2 hr]]{2 Conviction} (Foundry adds this automatically). You can pray instead — see Prayer Gamble.

  • Creed echo: the first act in your pact’s creed each round [[/gain 1 hr]]{gains 1 Conviction}: an act of mercy, protection, or aid (Light), or of dominion, punishment, or harvest (Dark).

Sustaining Workings

Sustaining a persistent working drains −2 Conviction per turn for each point of its Persistent rating (Persistent 1 = −2, Persistent 2 = −4).

Cap and Loss

Your Conviction cap is 8 at echelon 1, 12 at echelon 2, 16 at echelon 3, and 20 at echelon 4 (raised further by Burgeoning Saint / Rising Adept and Most Faithful, and lowered by chrome erosion). You lose all unspent Conviction at the end of the encounter.

Outside of Combat

You can’t gain Conviction outside combat, but you can use Conviction-costed effects as if you had Conviction equal to your Victories — ministry, healing, warding, and pact renewal in downtime scenes.

Firewall: Conviction never touches nuyen or Body Integrity, and chrome never generates it.

In Foundry, the +2 drip is automatic; the prayer gamble, creed echo, sustain drains, and cap use the buttons above.

PrayerGamble.Name: Prayer Gamble
PrayerGamble.Description:
At the start of your turn, instead of taking the flat +2 drip, you can pray: roll [[/r 1d6]].

  • 1–2: the flat drip only ([[/gain 2 hr]]{+2 Conviction}).

  • 3–4: [[/gain 4 hr]]{+4 Conviction}.

  • 5–6: [[/gain 4 hr]]{+4 Conviction}, and you immediately use Smite / Rebuke or Lay On Hands / Word of Comfort for free.

The gamble is resource-only: it never causes backlash, damage, or corruption. In Foundry, the automatic +2 drip still posts; if you pray, add only the difference (+2 more on a 3–6).

LightPact.Name: Light Pact
LightPact.Description:
Your patron is an angel or other Light power. This choice is permanent.

  • Default damage type: holy.

  • Corruption weight: light.

  • Conduct: strict — your patron demands mercy and protection tasks as the Price.

  • Creed echo: your first act of mercy, protection, or aid each round.

  • Invoke the Pact, failed bind: the entity vanishes without effect, and you take a bane on your next power rolls (save ends).

Your pact-named features are the Light versions: The Roster of the Saved, Burgeoning Saint, Consecrated Weapon, Ordained.

DarkPact.Name: Dark Pact
DarkPact.Description:
Your patron is a demon or other infernal power. This choice is permanent.

  • Default damage type: corruption.

  • Corruption weight: heavy.

  • Conduct: looser in the moment, but the debt comes due — your patron demands darker service or offerings as the Price.

  • Creed echo: your first act of dominion, punishment, or harvest each round.

  • Invoke the Pact, failed bind: the entity manifests just long enough to strike you once, for 4 + Persona damage, before departing.

Your pact-named features are the Dark versions: The Ledger of the Damned, Rising Adept, Damned Weapon, Sworn.

PriestsWard.Name: Priest’s Ward
PriestsWard.Description: At the start of each of your turns, if you aren’t sustaining another persistent working, you gain [[/heal 2 temp]]{2 temporary Stamina} — a small cushion that’s always there. This is separate from Sanctuary Ward.

RosterOfTheSaved.Name: The Roster of the Saved
RosterOfTheSaved.Description: Once per encounter, as a free action, you can ask the Director one factual question about a creature’s standing under your patron’s morality: is this person innocent? complicit? already marked by the patron? A narrative intel tool that also sets up Judgment and Discerning Eye.

LedgerOfTheDamned.Name: The Ledger of the Damned
LedgerOfTheDamned.Description: Once per encounter, as a free action, you can ask the Director one factual question about a creature’s standing under your patron’s morality: is this person guilty? indebted? already marked by the patron? A narrative intel tool that also sets up Judgment and Discerning Eye.

MinorMiracle.Name: Minor Miracle
MinorMiracle.Description: Once per encounter, you can spend a Recovery to bend a single outcome: reroll one power roll (yours or an ally’s within 10 squares), or improve a power roll that just happened by one result (low becomes middle, middle becomes high).

DeepenedSubclass.Name: Deepened Subclass
DeepenedSubclass.Description: Your ministry deepens: at 4th level you gain its 4th-level feature (Ward Anchor, Righteous Momentum, or Bound to Silence).

BurgeoningSaint.Name: Burgeoning Saint
BurgeoningSaint.Description: Your Conviction cap increases by 2, and a 5–6 on your Prayer Gamble also grants you [[/surge 1]].

RisingAdept.Name: Rising Adept
RisingAdept.Description: Your Conviction cap increases by 2, and a 5–6 on your Prayer Gamble also grants you [[/surge 1]].

PactsFavor.Name: Pact’s Favor
PactsFavor.Description: Once per session, your patron intervenes directly with a small favor outside combat: a piece of information, a door that’s unlocked when you arrive, a witness who suddenly remembers something. Director-adjudicated and never a combat-turn effect.

ConsecratedWeapon.Name: Consecrated Weapon
ConsecratedWeapon.Description: Your weapon strikes (through a Kit or otherwise) deal extra holy damage equal to [[lookup @P]]{your Persona score}. Templars gain this at 7th level through Blade of the Chosen.

DamnedWeapon.Name: Damned Weapon
DamnedWeapon.Description: Your weapon strikes (through a Kit or otherwise) deal extra corruption damage equal to [[lookup @P]]{your Persona score}. Templars gain this at 7th level through Blade of the Chosen.

Ordained.Name: Ordained
Ordained.Description: You bear the permanent title Ordained in your patron’s eyes, and you gain one perk of your choice (from this level’s perk grant).

Sworn.Name: Sworn
Sworn.Description: You bear the permanent title Sworn in your patron’s eyes, and you gain one perk of your choice (from this level’s perk grant).

AvatarOfThePact.Name: Avatar of the Pact
AvatarOfThePact.Description: Your epic capstone. Once per encounter, you briefly manifest your patron through you: for one round, your holy or corruption damage rolls gain an edge, and your Persona-based power rolls can’t result lower than middle (12–16).

ManifestWill.Name: Manifest Will
ManifestWill.Description: Once per encounter, you can spend 5 Conviction to succeed automatically on one power roll: it counts as a high (17+) result.

MostFaithful.Name: Most Faithful
MostFaithful.Description: Your Conviction cap increases by a final 4. When you roll a 1 or 2 on the Prayer Gamble, you automatically reroll it once.

LayOnHands.Name: Lay On Hands / Word of Comfort
LayOnHands.Effect_before0000000000: No roll. The target can spend a Recovery.
LayOnHands.Effect_spend00000000000: For each Conviction spent, choose one: target one additional ally within distance; end one effect on a target that a saving throw ends or that ends at the end of their turn; let a prone target stand; or give a target [[/heal @P temp]]{temporary Stamina equal to your Persona score}.

SmiteRebuke.Name: Smite / Rebuke
SmiteRebuke.Story: A bolt of the patron’s power.
SmiteRebuke.Effect_before0000000000: Damage is holy (Light pact) or corruption (Dark pact).
SmiteRebuke.Effect_spend00000000000: For each Conviction spent, the damage increases by 1. Instead of 1 extra damage, you can push the target 1 square, or (for 2 Conviction) the target has a bane on its next power roll.

SenseTheVeil.Name: Sense the Veil / Discern Spirits
SenseTheVeil.Effect_before0000000000: Read the Veil around you: the thinness of the Veil, corruption or possession, or one entity’s rank and nature. A simple read needs no roll; roll Instinct for a contested or deeper read.
SenseTheVeil.Tier1: You sense how thin the Veil is, or detect corruption or possession nearby.
SenseTheVeil.Tier2: You read an entity’s rank or nature, or identify a spirit, working, or possession.
SenseTheVeil.Tier3: As a middle result, and you learn a spirit’s true name.

Drain.Name: Drain
Drain.Tier2: You or one ally within 10 squares can spend a Recovery.
Drain.Tier3: You or one ally within 10 squares can spend a Recovery.

Rebuke.Name: Rebuke
Rebuke.Effect_before0000000000: Damage is holy (Light pact) or corruption (Dark pact). The pull can be vertical.

Lightfall.Name: Lightfall
Lightfall.Effect_before0000000000: You can teleport yourself and up to 2 allies in the area to unoccupied spaces in the area.

SacrificialOffer.Name: Sacrificial Offer
SacrificialOffer.Effect_before0000000000: Choose yourself or one ally within distance: they can impose a bane on the next power roll made against them before the end of their next turn.

WordOfRebuke.Name: Word of Rebuke
WordOfRebuke.Effect_before0000000000: Damage is holy (Light pact) or corruption (Dark pact).

WarriorsPrayer.Name: Warrior’s Prayer
WarriorsPrayer.Story: Holy by default; a Dark priest may reskin it as corruption.
WarriorsPrayer.Effect_before0000000000: You or one ally within distance gains [[/heal @P temp]]{temporary Stamina equal to your Persona score}.

Wither.Name: Wither
Wither.Tier1: If the target’s Persona is below your weak potency, it has a bane on its next power roll.
Wither.Tier2: If the target’s Persona is below your average potency, it has a bane on its next power roll.
Wither.Tier3: If the target’s Persona is below your strong potency, it has a bane on its next power roll.

MinorRebuke.Name: Minor Rebuke
MinorRebuke.Effect_before0000000000: Damage is holy (Light pact) or corruption (Dark pact).

WhisperOfComfort.Name: Whisper of Comfort
WhisperOfComfort.Story: Cheap enough to use every turn.
WhisperOfComfort.Effect_before0000000000: No roll. Choose one: the target gains [[/heal 2+@P temp]]{temporary Stamina equal to 2 + your Persona score}, or ends one minor ongoing effect (Director’s call on what’s minor — not a save-ends major condition).

CallTheThunderDown.Name: Call the Thunder Down
CallTheThunderDown.Effect_before0000000000: Damage is holy (Light pact) or corruption (Dark pact). (sonic-flavored). You can push each willing ally in the area the same distance, in a direction you choose.

SentinelSpirit.Name: Sentinel Spirit
SentinelSpirit.Story: A flare of your patron’s presence given brief shape.
SentinelSpirit.Effect_before0000000000:
You summon a size 2 guardian spirit that can’t be harmed, in an unoccupied space within distance, until the end of your next turn. You and your allies can move through its space; enemies can’t. Any enemy that moves within 2 squares of it for the first time in a round, or starts its turn there, takes damage equal to [[lookup @I]]{your Instinct score}. Damage is holy (Light pact) or corruption (Dark pact).

A taste of the summoner fantasy, without Invoke the Pact’s bind roll.

JudgmentsHammer.Name: Judgment’s Hammer
JudgmentsHammer.Effect_before0000000000: Damage is holy (Light pact) or corruption (Dark pact).

ViolenceWillNotAidThee.Name: Violence Will Not Aid Thee
ViolenceWillNotAidThee.Story: The patron turns the enemy’s violence back on them.
ViolenceWillNotAidThee.Effect_before0000000000: Lightning damage (or holy / corruption by pact, Director’s call). The next time the target deals damage this encounter, it takes retributive damage equal to this ability’s damage result.

MyLifeForYours.Name: My Life for Yours
MyLifeForYours.Story: Always costs you a piece of yourself.
MyLifeForYours.Trigger: The target starts their turn or takes damage.
MyLifeForYours.Effect_before0000000000: You spend a Recovery, and the target regains Stamina equal to your Recovery value ([[/heal @recoveries.recoveryValue]]).
MyLifeForYours.Effect_spend00000000000: For each additional Conviction spent, the target also ends one save-ends effect, or stands up if prone.

SanctuaryWard.Name: Sanctuary Ward
SanctuaryWard.Story: The Veil’s Ward verb as a working.
SanctuaryWard.Effect_before0000000000:
Distance: Aura 3 centered on a point within 5 squares, or one ally.

You raise a consecrated ward. Enemies take a bane on attacks against targets or squares inside the ward, and the ward resists corruption and possession effects trying to take hold inside it.

CorruptionsCurse.Name: Corruption’s Curse
CorruptionsCurse.Story: Dark by default; a Light priest may call it Sin-Weight.
CorruptionsCurse.Tier1: If the target’s Might is below your weak potency, it has damage weakness 5 (save ends).
CorruptionsCurse.Tier2: If the target’s Might is below your average potency, it has damage weakness 5 (save ends).
CorruptionsCurse.Tier3: If the target’s Might is below your strong potency, it has damage weakness 5 (save ends).

CurseOfTerror.Name: Curse of Terror
CurseOfTerror.Tier1: If the target’s Instinct is below your weak potency, it is frightened (save ends).
CurseOfTerror.Tier2: If the target’s Instinct is below your average potency, it is frightened (save ends).
CurseOfTerror.Tier3: If the target’s Instinct is below your strong potency, it is frightened (save ends).

FaithIsOurArmor.Name: Faith Is Our Armor
FaithIsOurArmor.Effect_before0000000000: You can target yourself instead of one ally.
FaithIsOurArmor.Tier1: Each target gains [[/heal 5 temp]]{5 temporary Stamina}.
FaithIsOurArmor.Tier2: Each target gains [[/heal 10 temp]]{10 temporary Stamina}.
FaithIsOurArmor.Tier3: Each target gains [[/heal 15 temp]]{15 temporary Stamina}.

SermonOfGrace.Name: Sermon of Grace
SermonOfGrace.Effect_before0000000000: No roll. Each target can spend a Recovery and end one effect on them that a saving throw ends or that ends at the end of their turn (or stand up if prone).

InvokeThePact.Name: Invoke the Pact
InvokeThePact.Effect_before0000000000:
You call your patron’s aid across the Veil. The bind check rolls Instinct, not Persona. The entity’s shape follows your ministry: an angelic or infernal warrior (Templar), a guardian or warding spirit (Shepherd), or a hunting or binding spirit (Exorcist).

The Price applies hardest here: a Light entity demands a task of mercy or protection; a Dark entity loads corruption and spirit attention on top of the working. Breaking the pact’s terms after invoking is a serious story beat.
InvokeThePact.Effect_persistent000000: Sustain the independent form (−4 Conviction per turn). The extension form has no sustain cost.
InvokeThePact.Tier1: Failed bind. Light pact: the entity vanishes without effect, and you take a bane on your next power rolls (save ends). Dark pact: the entity strikes you once for 4 + Persona damage before departing.
InvokeThePact.Tier2: Extension form: the entity acts on your turn as part of your own action economy (a smiting hand, a warding aegis, a spectral guardian), with no Stamina of its own. Its strike deals 4/7/10 + Persona by result, or it gives an equivalent support effect. No sustain cost; it lasts until the end of the encounter or until you release it.
InvokeThePact.Tier3: Independent form: the entity becomes its own figure on the map with its own Stamina and turn, scaled as a high-grade entity (Veil rules), for the rest of the encounter or until it drops or the bind breaks. Sustain: Persistent 2 (−4 Conviction per turn).

FearOfTheGods.Name: Fear of the Gods
FearOfTheGods.Effect_before0000000000: Damage is holy (Light pact) or corruption (Dark pact). Each frightened target is frightened of you or a creature you choose within distance.
FearOfTheGods.Tier1: If the target’s Instinct is below your weak potency, it is frightened (save ends).
FearOfTheGods.Tier2: If the target’s Instinct is below your average potency, it is frightened (save ends).
FearOfTheGods.Tier3: If the target’s Instinct is below your strong potency, it is frightened (save ends).

SaintsRaiment.Name: Saint’s Raiment
SaintsRaiment.Story: Make one ally nearly unkillable this fight.
SaintsRaiment.Effect_before0000000000: No roll. The target gains [[/heal 20 temp]]{20 temporary Stamina} and [[/surge 3]].

SoulSiphon.Name: Soul Siphon
SoulSiphon.Effect_before0000000000: One ally within distance can spend any number of Recoveries.

WordsOfWrathAndGrace.Name: Words of Wrath and Grace
WordsOfWrathAndGrace.Story: Wrath for them, grace for us.
WordsOfWrathAndGrace.Effect_before0000000000: The damage hits each enemy in the area (damage is holy (light pact) or corruption (dark pact).). Each ally in the area can spend a Recovery.

BeaconOfGrace.Name: Beacon of Grace
BeaconOfGrace.Effect_before0000000000: Damage is holy (Light pact) or corruption (Dark pact). Until the end of the encounter, whenever an ally deals damage to the target, that ally or another ally can spend a Recovery.

Penance.Name: Penance
Penance.Tier1: If the target’s Instinct is below your weak potency, it is prone and can’t stand (save ends).
Penance.Tier2: If the target’s Instinct is below your average potency, it is prone and can’t stand (save ends).
Penance.Tier3: If the target’s Instinct is below your strong potency, it is prone and can’t stand (save ends).

Sanctuary.Name: Sanctuary
Sanctuary.Effect_before0000000000: No roll. The target is removed from the map until the start of their next turn, safe across the Veil, and can spend any number of Recoveries. At the start of their turn they reappear in the space they left or the nearest unoccupied space of your choice.

VesselOfRetribution.Name: Vessel of Retribution
VesselOfRetribution.Story: The patron’s fury at the moment an ally falls.
VesselOfRetribution.Effect_before0000000000: No roll. The first time the target is winded or dying before the end of the encounter, each enemy within 5 squares of them takes 15 damage. Damage is holy (Light pact) or corruption (Dark pact).

Arise.Name: Arise!
Arise.Story: The closest thing to a battlefield resurrection.
Arise.Effect_before0000000000: No roll. The target — even one at 0 Stamina or below — can spend any number of Recoveries, ends effects on them that a saving throw ends or that end at the end of their turn, and stands up. At the start of each of their turns until the end of the encounter or until they are dying, the target [[/surge 3]].

BlessingOfSteel.Name: Blessing of Steel
BlessingOfSteel.Effect_before0000000000: No roll. Until the end of the encounter, ability rolls against allies in the aura take a bane, and allies in the aura have damage immunity 5.

BlessingOfTheBlade.Name: Blessing of the Blade
BlessingOfTheBlade.Effect_before0000000000: No roll. At the end of each of your turns until the end of the encounter or until you are dying, each target in the aura [[/surge 3]].

DragTheUnworthy.Name: Drag the Unworthy
DragTheUnworthy.Effect_before0000000000: Damage is holy (Light pact) or corruption (Dark pact). Each ally the target comes adjacent to during the slide can spend a Recovery.

Shepherd.Name: Shepherd
Shepherd.Description:
“Pastoral-care specialist.” The crew’s lifeline: stronger healing, more temporary Stamina, better status removal. The most support-tilted ministry. Your Invoke the Pact entity is a guardian or warding spirit that sticks close to allies.

At 1st level you gain the Medicine skill, the Warden’s Grace feature, and a Shepherd ability of your choice.

WardensGrace.Name: Warden’s Grace
WardensGrace.Description: Whenever you use Lay On Hands / Word of Comfort, a target who spends a Recovery regains extra Stamina equal to [[lookup @P]]{your Persona score}.

WardAnchor.Name: Ward Anchor
WardAnchor.Description: Sanctuary Ward, and every persistent ally-buffing zone you sustain, drains 1 less Conviction per turn (minimum 1).

ShepherdsBounty.Name: Shepherd’s Bounty
ShepherdsBounty.Description: Your healing and warding workings (My Life for Yours, Sanctuary Ward, Faith Is Our Armor, Sermon of Grace) increase in magnitude by one step: +1 Recovery spent, +5 temporary Stamina, or +1 square of area (Director’s call per ability).

GuardiansVoice.Name: Guardian’s Voice
GuardiansVoice.Description: Whenever you use Sermon of Grace (or a similar buff), choose: it costs 1 less Conviction, or its range or area increases by 2.

ShepherdsDevotion.Name: Shepherd’s Devotion
ShepherdsDevotion.Description: Warden’s Grace’s extra Stamina doubles, and Ward Anchor’s discount also applies to sustaining Invoke the Pact’s independent form.

SteadyHand.Name: Steady Hand
SteadyHand.Description: Lay On Hands / Word of Comfort can target 2 allies instead of 1 for 1 extra Conviction.

WardSense.Name: Ward-Sense
WardSense.Description: Sense the Veil / Discern Spirits also detects the nearest hostile ward or trap within 10 squares.

CircleOfMercy.Name: Circle of Mercy
CircleOfMercy.Description: Sanctuary Ward’s bane also applies to enemies attacking into the ward from outside it.

RecoveringGrace.Name: Recovering Grace
RecoveringGrace.Description: You can use My Life for Yours proactively at the start of the target’s turn, without the target having taken damage this round.

UnbrokenWatch.Name: Unbroken Watch
UnbrokenWatch.Description: Faith Is Our Armor’s temporary Stamina lasts until the end of the encounter.

AegisBound.Name: Aegis Bound
AegisBound.Description: While your guardian spirit (Invoke the Pact, extension form) exists, attacks against allies adjacent to it take a bane.

TheShepherdsHour.Name: The Shepherd’s Hour
TheShepherdsHour.Description: Once per encounter, as a free action when an ally would drop to 0 Stamina, you grant them a full Recovery instead, at no Conviction cost.

Templar.Name: Templar
Templar.Description:
“Militant-order asset.” The holy warrior: more smiting damage, sturdier on the front line, and the only ministry with Judgment. Your Invoke the Pact entity is an angelic or infernal warrior. A Templar often takes the Sanctified Kit or a martial Kit to hold the line.

At 1st level you gain the Melee skill, the Judgment ability, and a Templar ability of your choice.

Judgment.Name: Judgment
Judgment.Effect_before0000000000:
The target is [[/apply SPR0000000judged]]{under Judgment} until the end of the encounter, until you are dying, or until you use this ability on another target (only one target at a time; Twin Judgment at 8th level allows two). While the mark holds:

  • The target takes a bane on power rolls it makes while within your line of effect. Judgment grants no bonus damage of its own.

  • The first time each round you damage the target, or it damages you, you [[/gain 1 hr]]{gain 1 Conviction} (+1 more with Righteous Momentum).

RighteousMomentum.Name: Righteous Momentum
RighteousMomentum.Description: Judgment’s Conviction gain increases by 1: [[/gain 2 hr]]{2 Conviction} the first time each round.

SmitersZeal.Name: Smiter’s Zeal
